jobs.description:
Doctoral Fellowships in Architecture and Technology

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

The Architecture & Technology (A&T) Doctoral Programme is looking for exceptional candidates to join our group of 50+ international doctoral students. We are offering two paid, full-time (100%), 3.5-year doctoral fellowships to start on October 1, 2027 .

Since its inauguration, 32 scholars have been granted an A&T Fellowship. Graduates of the programme have successfully obtained academic positions at leading research institutions worldwide and high-level positions in the industry.

The programme provides funding for three and a half years. It offers excellent working conditions and a unique research infrastructure. You will be employed full-time and receive monthly salaries based on a standard rate .

Please find the detailed information about the doctorate at ETH Zurich in the AVETH survival guide .

Project background

About the Programme

The A&T Doctoral Programme is ETH Zurich’s interdisciplinary educational platform committed to training scholars in research and teaching of technology in architecture. The programme is offered and managed collaboratively by the chairs of the Institute of Technology in Architecture (ITA) . The work of the ITA chairs assimilates many diverse aspects of employing science, technology and engineering in architecture, including computational design of buildings and structures, building processes and systems, digital and robotic construction and fabrication, and many others. For more information about our institute, please consult the ITA website .

The following professorships are currently involved in the A&T doctoral programme:
• Architecture and Digital Fabrication (Gramazio Kohler Research)
• Architecture and Structures (Block Research Group)
• Structural Design
• Digital Building Technologies (DBT)
• Architecture and Building Systems (A/S)
• Construction Heritage and Preservation
• Architecture and Human Augmentation

You will join one of the above professorships under the respective professor/mentor. Hence, we expect you to choose one professorship most suitable for realising your research proposal and explicitly indicate this in your application packages. Although the selected applicant will be primarily associated with the chosen professorship, the interdisciplinary character of the programme ensures the involvement of other parties during the studies. For example, one of the milestones of this doctoral programme is the Aptitude Colloquium, in which doctoral students defend their research plan before all ITA professors and researchers. Our work takes place in the Arch_Tec_Lab , a high-tech zero-emissions building designed and developed by ITA.

Job description
• We are looking for excellent people whose work demonstrates productive synergies between architecture and technology
• We welcome architects with a solid technical, engineering or scientific background or interests and engineers/scientists whose work relates to architecture
• We advise the applicants to thoroughly consult the ITA professorships’ websites before applying to ensure their research interests are compatible

Profile
• You must hold a Master’s degree acquired at the university level in architecture, engineering or related fields (e.g., MSc, MEng or MArch)
• Upon successful admission, depending on the your academic background, the ETH administration office will evaluate if you need to take any additional exams at ETH during your first year of studies
• English is the official language, and we assume you are proficient in this language
• We do not formally require English language certificates as a part of the application package

We offer
• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society
• You can expect numerous benefits , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ , childcare and attractive pension benefits

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with only the following four documents (each a single file in PDF format):
• Cover Letter (1 page max, submitted as pdf file, named: Lastname_Firstname_Cover Letter.pdf), stating: The applicant’s career plans, reasons for pursuing a doctorate in Architecture & Technology at ETH Zurich, arguments why they would be the right candidate, the relevance of their background/past experiences in pursuing a doctorate and under which ITA professorship they wish to conduct their studies (only one please)
• CV (3 page max, submitted as pdf file, named: Lastname_Firstname_Short CV.pdf), outlining: The applicant's academic/professional progression, academic/professional achievements, clearly articulated set of competencies and skills (relevant to the job), list of awards, publications, and/or other notable milestones and details of 3 referees (their name, professional title, organisation, email address), whom we may contact
• Portfolio (12 pages max, submitted as pdf file, named: Lastname_Firstname_Portfolio.pdf), to include: Amages/graphic content illustrating projects relevant to the job, short descriptions of the projects included, and short research articles (if existing and relevant)
• Research Statement (3 pages max, submitted as pdf file, named: Lastname_Firstname_Research Statement.pdf), to include: The identification of the principal research, field(s) or topic(s) of interest, an outline and a summary of the research proposal

Further information about our institute can be found on our website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Ms. Ewa Maciejewski, ita-phd-fellowship@arch.ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we accept applications submitted exclusively through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

The submission deadline for the application package is January 31, 2027. Incomplete submissions will not be considered. The timeline is as follows:

•
Until January 31, 2027: Applicants should submit their applications, after the initial screening, the eligible application packages are forwarded to the corresponding professorships and after internal assessments and interviews, each professorship may select their candidate for the shortlist

•
Mid-March 2027: Shortlisted applicants are invited for an online interview with all participating professors

•
Latest by April 1, 2027: Applicants are notified about the outcome of the application process

When uploading requested documents choose the following attachment types:
• For a cover letter, select "Cover Letter"
• For a curriculum vitae, select "CV"
• For a research statement, select "Other" and add the comment "Research Statement" (without quotes)
• For a portfolio of work samples, select "Application Package"

Please do not attach any additional documents, especially passport/ID scans, school records and letters of recommendation (they are handled separately).

About ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in
science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education,
cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge
into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our
university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an
environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe,
yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to
develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dottorato in Architettura e Tecnologia

100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato

The Architecture & Technology (A&T) Doctoral Programme sta cercando candidati eccezionali per aderire al nostro gruppo di 50 studenti di dottorato internazionali. Stiamo offrendo due borse a tempo pieno (100%), borse di dottorato 3,5 anni per iniziare il 1 ottobre 2027 .

Dalla sua inaugurazione, 32 studiosi hanno ricevuto una A&T Fellowship. I laureati del programma hanno ottenuto con successo posizioni accademiche nei principali istituti di ricerca in tutto il mondo e posizioni di alto livello nel settore.

Il programma prevede finanziamenti per tre anni e mezzo. Offre eccellenti condizioni di lavoro e un'infrastruttura di ricerca unica. Sarete impiegati a tempo pieno e ricevere gli stipendi mensili in base a un tasso standard.

Si prega di trovare le informazioni dettagliate sul dottorato presso ETH Zurich nella guida di sopravvivenza AVETH .

Sfondo del progetto

Informazioni sul programma

Il programma A&T Doctoral è la piattaforma educativa interdisciplinare di Zurigo impegnata nella formazione di studiosi nella ricerca e nell’insegnamento della tecnologia nell’architettura. Il programma è offerto e gestito in collaborazione dalle sedie dell'Istituto di Tecnologia in Architettura (ITA) . Il lavoro delle sedie ITA assimila molti diversi aspetti dell'utilizzo della scienza, della tecnologia e dell'ingegneria in architettura, tra cui la progettazione computazionale di edifici e strutture, processi edili e sistemi, la costruzione digitale e robotica e la fabbricazione, e molti altri. Per ulteriori informazioni sul nostro istituto, consultare il sito ITA .

Attualmente sono coinvolte nel programma di dottorato A&T:
• Architettura e Digital Fabrication (Gramazio Kohler Research)
• Architettura e strutture (Block Research Group)
• Progettazione strutturale
• Tecnologie per l'edilizia digitale (DBT)
• Architettura e sistemi di costruzione (A/S)
• Patrimonio edilizio e conservazione
• Architettura e Aumento Umano

Ti unirai a una delle suddette cattedrali sotto il rispettivo professore/mentatore. Quindi, ci aspettiamo che tu scelga una cattedra più adatta per realizzare la tua proposta di ricerca e lo indichi esplicitamente nei tuoi pacchetti applicativi. Anche se il richiedente selezionato sarà associato principalmente alla cattedra scelta, il carattere interdisciplinare del programma assicura il coinvolgimento di altre parti durante gli studi. Ad esempio, una delle pietre miliari di questo programma di dottorato è l'Aptitude Colloquium, in cui gli studenti di dottorato difendono il loro piano di ricerca prima di tutti i professori e ricercatori ITA. Il nostro lavoro si svolge nella Arch Tec Lab , un edificio ad alta tecnologia a zero emissioni progettato e sviluppato da ITA.

Descrizione del lavoro
• Stiamo cercando persone eccellenti il cui lavoro dimostra sinergie produttive tra architettura e tecnologia
• Accogliamo gli architetti con un solido background tecnico, ingegneristico o scientifico o interessi e ingegneri/scienziati il cui lavoro si riferisce all'architettura
• Consigliamo ai candidati di consultare attentamente i siti web delle professorship ITA prima di applicarsi per garantire che i loro interessi di ricerca siano compatibili

Profilo
• È necessario tenere un master acquisito a livello universitario in architettura, ingegneria o campi correlati (ad esempio, MSc, MEng o MArch)
• Dopo l'ammissione di successo, a seconda del vostro background accademico, l'ufficio di amministrazione ETH valuterà se è necessario sostenere eventuali esami aggiuntivi a ETH durante il vostro primo anno di studi
• L'inglese è la lingua ufficiale e presumiamo che tu sia competente in questa lingua
• Non chiediamo formalmente i certificati di lingua inglese come parte del pacchetto di applicazione

Offriamo
• Il tuo lavoro con impatto: Diventa parte dell'ETH di Zurigo, che non solo supporta lo sviluppo professionale, ma contribuisce attivamente al cambiamento positivo nella società
• È possibile aspettarsi numerosi vantaggi, come i biglietti per la stagione dei trasporti pubblici e la condivisione delle auto, una vasta gamma di sport offerti dalla ASVZ , l'assistenza all'infanzia e le interessanti prestazioni pensionistiche

Apprezziamo la diversità e la sostenibilità

In linea con i nostri valori, ETH Zurich incoraggia una cultura inclusiva. Promuoviamo l'uguaglianza di opportunità, la diversità di valore e nutrire un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento in cui i diritti e la dignità di tutto il nostro staff e gli studenti sono rispettati. Visita il nostro sito web Equal Opportunities and Diversity per scoprire come garantiamo un ambiente equo e aperto che permetta a tutti di crescere e fiorire. La sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale per noi – stiamo costantemente lavorando verso un futuro neutro dal clima.

Curioso? Anche noi.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione online con solo i seguenti quattro documenti (ogni singolo file in formato PDF):
• Copertina (1 pagina max, presentata come file pdf, denominata: Lastname Firstname Cover Letter.pdf), dichiarando: I piani di carriera del richiedente, i motivi per perseguire un dottorato in Architettura e Tecnologia all’ETH di Zurigo, argomentano perché sarebbero stati il candidato giusto, la pertinenza delle loro esperienze di background/past nel perseguire un dottorato e sotto il quale la cattedra ITA desiderano condurre i loro studi (solo una per favore)
• CV (3 pagina max, presentato come file pdf, denominato: Lastname Firstname Short CV.pdf), sottolineando: Progressione accademica/professionale del richiedente, risultati accademici/professionali, set chiaramente articolato di competenze e competenze (rilevante al lavoro), elenco di premi, pubblicazioni, e/o altre pietre miliari e dettagli notevoli di 3 arbitri (il loro nome, titolo professionale, organizzazione, indirizzo e-mail), che possiamo contattare
• Portfolio (12 pagine max, sottoposte come file pdf, denominato: Lastname Firstname Portfolio.pdf), per includere: Amages / contenuto grafico che illustra i progetti relativi al lavoro, brevi descrizioni dei progetti inclusi, e brevi articoli di ricerca (se esistenti e pertinenti)
• Dichiarazione di ricerca (3 pagine max, presentata come file pdf, denominata: Lastname Firstname Research Statement.pdf), per includere: L'identificazione della principale ricerca, campo(i) o argomento(i) di interesse, un profilo e un riassunto della proposta di ricerca

Ulteriori informazioni sul nostro istituto possono essere trovate sul nostro sito web . Le domande relative alla posizione devono essere indirizzate alla signora Ewa Maciejewski, ita-phd-fellowship@arch.ethz.ch (nessuna domanda).

Si prega di notare che accettiamo le domande presentate esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di applicazioni online. Le applicazioni via e-mail o servizi postali non saranno considerate.

Il termine di presentazione per il pacchetto domanda è il 31 gennaio 2027. Le osservazioni incomplete non saranno considerate. La linea temporale è la seguente:

•
Fino al 31 gennaio 2027: i candidati devono presentare le loro domande, dopo la proiezione iniziale, i pacchetti di candidatura idonei sono inoltrati alle corrispondenti borse di studio e dopo le valutazioni interne e le interviste, ogni cattedra può selezionare il loro candidato per la lista breve

•
Mid-March 2027: I candidati a lista corta sono invitati per un colloquio online con tutti i professori partecipanti

•
Ultimo entro il 1 aprile 2027: I candidati sono informati circa l'esito del processo di applicazione

Quando si caricano i documenti richiesti, scegliere i seguenti tipi di allegati:
• Per una lettera di copertura, selezionare "Cover Letter"
• Per un curriculum vitae, selezionare "CV"
• Per una dichiarazione di ricerca, selezionare "Altro" e aggiungere il commento "Dichiarazione di ricerca" (senza citazioni)
• Per un portafoglio di campioni di lavoro, selezionare "Application Package"

Si prega di non allegare alcun documento aggiuntivo, in particolare le scansioni di passaporto/ID, i registri scolastici e le lettere di raccomandazione (sono gestiti separatamente).

Informazioni su ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich è una delle università più importanti del mondo specializzata in
scienza e tecnologia. Siamo rinomati per la nostra eccellente educazione,
ricerca fondamentale all'avanguardia e trasferimento diretto di nuove conoscenze
nella società. Oltre 30.000 persone provenienti da più di 120 paesi trovano la nostra
università per essere un luogo che promuove il pensiero indipendente e un
ambiente che ispira eccellenza. Situato nel cuore dell'Europa,
ancora forgiando connessioni in tutto il mondo, lavoriamo insieme a
sviluppare soluzioni per le sfide globali di oggi e di domani.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Promotionsstipendien in Architektur und Technologie

100%, Zürich, befristet

Das Architektur & Technologie (A & T) Doktorandenprogramm sucht nach außergewöhnlichen Kandidaten für unsere Gruppe von 50 + internationalen Doktoranden. Wir bieten zwei bezahlte Vollzeit (100%), 3,5-jährige Promotionsstipendien an, die am 1. Oktober 2027 beginnen.

Seit seiner Einweihung erhielten 32 Wissenschaftler ein A & T Fellowship. Die Absolventen des Programms haben erfolgreich akademische Positionen an führenden Forschungseinrichtungen weltweit und hochrangige Positionen in der Industrie erhalten.

Das Programm sieht eine Finanzierung für dreieinhalb Jahre vor. Es bietet hervorragende Arbeitsbedingungen und eine einzigartige Forschungsinfrastruktur. Sie werden Vollzeit beschäftigt und erhalten monatliche Gehälter basierend auf einem Standardsatz.

Detaillierte Informationen zum Doktorat an der ETH Zürich finden Sie im AVETH Survival Guide.

Projekthintergrund

Über das Programm

Das A&T Doktorandenprogramm ist die interdisziplinäre Bildungsplattform der ETH Zürich, die sich der Ausbildung von Wissenschaftlern in der Forschung und Lehre von Technologie in der Architektur verschrieben hat. Das Programm wird gemeinsam von den Lehrstühlen des Institute of Technology in Architecture (ITA) angeboten und verwaltet. Die Arbeit der ITA-Lehrstühle assimiliert viele verschiedene Aspekte des Einsatzes von Wissenschaft, Technologie und Ingenieurwesen in der Architektur, einschließlich der computergestützten Gestaltung von Gebäuden und Strukturen, Bauprozessen und -systemen, digitaler und robotergestützter Konstruktion und Fertigung und vielen anderen. Für weitere Informationen über unser Institut konsultieren Sie bitte die ITA-Website.

Folgende Professuren sind derzeit am A&T Promotionsprogramm beteiligt:
• Architektur und digitale Fabrikation (Gramazio Kohler Research)
• Architektur und Strukturen (Block Research Group)
• Strukturelle Konstruktion
• Digitale Gebäudetechnologien (DBT)
• Architektur und Gebäudesysteme (A/S)
• Bauerbe und Erhaltung
• Architektur und Human Augmentation

Sie werden einer der oben genannten Professuren unter dem jeweiligen Professor/Mentor beitreten. Daher erwarten wir von Ihnen, dass Sie eine Professur auswählen, die sich am besten für die Realisierung Ihres Forschungsvorschlags eignet und dies in Ihren Bewerbungspaketen ausdrücklich angeben. Obwohl der ausgewählte Bewerber in erster Linie mit der gewählten Professur assoziiert wird, gewährleistet der interdisziplinäre Charakter des Programms die Beteiligung anderer Parteien während des Studiums. Einer der Meilensteine dieses Promotionsprogramms ist beispielsweise das Aptitude Colloquium, in dem Doktoranden ihren Forschungsplan vor allen ITA-Professoren und Forschern verteidigen. Unsere Arbeit findet im Arch Tec Lab statt, einem von ITA entworfenen und entwickelten Hightech-Null-Emissionsgebäude.

Stellenbeschreibung
• Wir suchen exzellente Menschen, deren Arbeit produktive Synergien zwischen Architektur und Technologie zeigt
• Wir begrüßen Architekten mit einem soliden technischen, technischen oder wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund oder Interessen und Ingenieure / Wissenschaftler, deren Arbeit sich auf die Architektur bezieht
• Wir empfehlen den Bewerbern, die Websites der ITA-Professuren vor der Bewerbung gründlich zu konsultieren, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Forschungsinteressen vereinbar sind.

Profil
• Sie müssen einen Master-Abschluss besitzen, der auf Hochschulebene in Architektur, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder verwandten Bereichen erworben wurde (z. B. MSc, MEng oder MArch)
• Nach erfolgreicher Zulassung prüft die ETH-Verwaltung je nach akademischem Hintergrund, ob Sie im ersten Studienjahr zusätzliche Prüfungen an der ETH ablegen müssen.
• Englisch ist die Amtssprache, und wir gehen davon aus, dass Sie diese Sprache beherrschen
• Wir verlangen formal keine englischen Sprachzertifikate als Teil des Bewerbungspakets

Wir bieten
• Ihr Job mit Impact: Werden Sie Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur Ihre berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zum positiven Wandel in der Gesellschaft beiträgt
• Sie können zahlreiche Vorteile erwarten, wie Saisontickets für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr und Carsharing, eine breite Palette von Sportangeboten des ASVZ, Kinderbetreuung und attraktive Pensionsleistungen.

Wir legen Wert auf Vielfalt und Nachhaltigkeit

Im Einklang mit unseren Werten fördert die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit, schätzen Vielfalt und fördern ein Arbeits- und Lernumfeld, in dem die Rechte und die Würde aller unserer Mitarbeiter und Studenten respektiert werden. Besuchen Sie unsere Website für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt, um herauszufinden, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld gewährleisten, in dem jeder wachsen und gedeihen kann. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert – wir arbeiten konsequent auf eine klimaneutrale Zukunft hin.

Neugierig? So sind wir.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung mit nur den folgenden vier Dokumenten (jeweils eine einzige Datei im PDF-Format):
• Anschreiben (1 Seite max, eingereicht als PDF-Datei, mit dem Namen: Lastname Firstname Cover Letter.pdf), mit folgenden Worten: Karrierepläne des Bewerbers, Gründe für die Promotion in Architektur & Technik an der ETH Zürich, Argumente, warum er der richtige Kandidat wäre, Relevanz seines Hintergrunds/seiner früheren Erfahrungen bei der Promotion und unter welcher ITA-Professur er sein Studium durchführen möchte (bitte nur eine)
• CV (3 Seite max, eingereicht als PDF-Datei mit dem Namen: Lastname Firstname Short CV.pdf), umreißt: Der akademische / berufliche Fortschritt des Bewerbers, akademische / berufliche Leistungen, klar artikulierte Kompetenzen und Fähigkeiten (relevant für den Job), Liste der Auszeichnungen, Veröffentlichungen und / oder andere bemerkenswerte Meilensteine und Details von 3 Schiedsrichtern (Name, Berufsbezeichnung, Organisation, E-Mail-Adresse), mit denen wir uns in Verbindung setzen können
• Portfolio (12 Seiten max., eingereicht als PDF-Datei, benannt: Lastname Firstname Portfolio.pdf), um Folgendes zu enthalten: Änderungen/grafische Inhalte, die Projekte illustrieren, die für den Auftrag relevant sind, kurze Beschreibungen der Projekte und kurze Forschungsartikel (falls vorhanden und relevant)
• Research Statement (3 Seiten max, eingereicht als PDF-Datei, mit dem Namen: Lastname Firstname Research Statement.pdf), um Folgendes einzuschließen: Die Identifizierung der Hauptforschung, der Fachgebiete oder Themen von Interesse, eine Gliederung und eine Zusammenfassung des Forschungsvorschlags

Weitere Informationen zu unserem Institut finden Sie auf unserer Website. Fragen zur Stelle richten Sie bitte an Frau Ewa Maciejewski, ita-phd-fellowship@arch.ethz.ch (keine Bewerbungen).

Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir Bewerbungen ausschließlich über unser Online-Bewerbungsportal annehmen. Bewerbungen per E-Mail oder Post werden nicht berücksichtigt.

Die Einreichungsfrist für das Bewerbungspaket ist der 31. Januar 2027. Unvollständige Einreichungen werden nicht berücksichtigt. Der Zeitplan sieht wie folgt aus:

•
Spätestens bis zum 1. April 2027: Bewerber werden über das Ergebnis des Bewerbungsverfahrens informiert

Beim Hochladen der angeforderten Dokumente wählen Sie die folgenden Anlagetypen:

• Für einen Lebenslauf wählen Sie "CV"

Bitte fügen Sie keine zusätzlichen Dokumente bei, insbesondere Pass- / ID-Scans, Schulunterlagen und Empfehlungsschreiben (sie werden separat behandelt).

Über die ETH Zürich

Die ETH Zürich ist eine der weltweit führenden Universitäten, die sich auf
Wissenschaft und Technologie. Wir sind bekannt für unsere hervorragende Ausbildung,
Spitzenforschung und direkter Wissenstransfer
in die Gesellschaft. Über 30.000 Menschen aus mehr als 120 Ländern finden unsere
Universität ein Ort zu sein, der unabhängiges Denken und eine
Umwelt, die Exzellenz inspiriert. Im Herzen Europas gelegen,
Dennoch knüpfen wir Verbindungen auf der ganzen Welt, wir arbeiten zusammen, um
Lösungen für die globalen Herausforderungen von heute und morgen zu entwickeln.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bourses de doctorat en architecture et technologie

100%, Zurich, durée déterminée

Le programme de doctorat en architecture et technologie (A & T) cherche des candidats exceptionnels pour rejoindre notre groupe de 50 étudiants de doctorat internationaux. Nous offrons deux bourses de doctorat rémunérées à temps plein (100 %), de 3,5 ans pour commencer le 1er octobre 2027.

Depuis son inauguration, 32 chercheurs ont reçu une bourse de recherche en A-T. Les diplômés du programme ont obtenu avec succès des postes universitaires dans les principaux établissements de recherche du monde entier et des postes de haut niveau dans l'industrie.

Le programme prévoit un financement de trois ans et demi. Il offre d'excellentes conditions de travail et une infrastructure de recherche unique. Vous serez employé à temps plein et recevrez des salaires mensuels basés sur un taux standard.

Veuillez trouver les informations détaillées sur le doctorat à l'ETH Zurich dans le guide de survie AVETH .

Contexte du projet

À propos du programme

Le programme de doctorat en A & T est une plateforme interdisciplinaire de formation à l'enseignement de la technologie en architecture. Le programme est offert et géré en collaboration par les présidents de l'Institut de technologie en architecture (ITA). Le travail des chaises ITA assimile de nombreux aspects de l'utilisation de la science, de la technologie et de l'ingénierie dans l'architecture, y compris la conception informatique des bâtiments et des structures, les processus et les systèmes de construction, la construction et la fabrication numérique et robotique, et bien d'autres. Pour plus d'informations sur notre institut, veuillez consulter le site Internet ITA .

Les professeurs suivants participent actuellement au programme de doctorat en A-T :
• Architecture et fabrication numérique (Gramazio Kohler Research)
• Architecture et structures (Block Research Group)
• Conception structurelle
• Technologies de construction numérique (DBT)
• Architecture et systèmes de construction (A/S)
• Patrimoine et préservation de la construction
• Architecture et augmentation humaine

Vous rejoindrez l'un des professeurs ci-dessus sous le professeur/menteur respectif. Par conséquent, nous vous attendons à choisir un poste de professeur le mieux adapté pour réaliser votre proposition de recherche et l'indiquer explicitement dans vos dossiers de candidature. Bien que le candidat choisi soit principalement associé à la chaire choisie, le caractère interdisciplinaire du programme assure la participation d'autres parties au cours des études. Par exemple, l'un des jalons de ce programme de doctorat est le Colloque Aptitude, dans lequel les doctorants défendent leur plan de recherche devant tous les professeurs et chercheurs de l'ITA. Nos travaux se déroulent dans l'Arch Tec Lab , un bâtiment de haute technologie à émissions nulles conçu et développé par ITA.

Description du poste
• Nous recherchons d'excellentes personnes dont le travail démontre des synergies productives entre architecture et technologie
• Nous accueillons des architectes avec une solide expérience technique, technique ou scientifique ou des intérêts et des ingénieurs/scientifiques dont le travail concerne l'architecture
• Nous conseillons aux candidats de consulter en détail les sites web des professeurs de l'ITA avant de postuler pour s'assurer que leurs intérêts de recherche sont compatibles

Profil
• Vous devez être titulaire d'une maîtrise acquise au niveau universitaire en architecture, en génie ou dans des domaines connexes (p. ex., maîtrise, maîtrise en génie ou maîtrise en génie)
• Une fois l'admission réussie, selon votre formation, le bureau d'administration de l'ETH évaluera si vous devez passer des examens supplémentaires à l'ETH pendant votre première année d'études.
• L'anglais est la langue officielle, et nous supposons que vous maîtrisez cette langue
• Nous n'exigeons pas formellement des certificats de langue anglaise dans le cadre du dossier de candidature

Nous offrons
• Votre travail avec impact: Devenez membre de l'ETH Zurich, qui non seulement soutient votre développement professionnel, mais contribue également activement au changement positif dans la société
• Vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreux avantages , tels que les billets de saison de transport en commun et le partage de voiture , un large éventail de sports offerts par l'ASVZ , garde d'enfants et prestations de retraite attrayantes

Nous apprécions la diversité et la durabilité

Conformément à nos valeurs, ETH Zurich encourage une culture inclusive. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances, valorisons la diversité et favorisons un environnement de travail et d'apprentissage dans lequel les droits et la dignité de tous nos employés et étudiants sont respectés. Visitez notre site Web sur l'égalité des chances et la diversité pour découvrir comment nous garantissons un environnement équitable et ouvert qui permet à tous de grandir et de prospérer. La durabilité est une valeur fondamentale pour nous – nous travaillons constamment vers un avenir neutre sur le plan climatique.

Curieux ? Nous aussi.

Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre demande en ligne avec seulement les quatre documents suivants (chaque fichier en format PDF) :
• Lettre de présentation (1 page max, soumise en format pdf, nommée : Nom Prénom Cover Letter.pdf), indiquant : Le candidat plan de carrière, les raisons de poursuivre un doctorat en architecture et technologie à l'ETH Zurich, argumente pourquoi ils seraient le bon candidat, la pertinence de leurs expériences de formation / passé dans la poursuite d'un doctorat et en vertu de laquelle professeur ITA ils souhaitent conduire leurs études (un seul s'il vous plaît)
• CV (3 page max, soumis en fichier pdf, nommé: Nom Prénom Court CV.pdf), décrivant: La progression académique/professionnelle du candidat, les réalisations académiques/professionnelles, un ensemble clairement défini de compétences et de compétences (pertinentes à l'emploi), la liste des prix, des publications et/ou d'autres jalons importants et les détails de 3 répondants (nom, titre professionnel, organisation, adresse électronique), que nous pouvons contacter
• Portfolio (12 pages max, soumis sous forme de fichier pdf, nommé: Nom Prénom Portfolio.pdf), à inclure: Amages/contenu graphique illustrant les projets pertinents au travail, brèves descriptions des projets inclus, et courts articles de recherche (si existants et pertinents)
• Énoncé de recherche (3 pages max, présenté en fichier pdf, nommé : Nom Prénom Énoncé de recherche.pdf), pour inclure : L'identification du principal domaine de recherche, du ou des sujets d'intérêt, un aperçu et un résumé de la proposition de recherche

De plus amples informations sur notre institut sont disponibles sur notre site . Les questions concernant le poste doivent être adressées à Mme Ewa Maciejewski, ita-phd-fellowship@arch.ethz.ch (aucune demande).

Veuillez noter que nous acceptons les demandes soumises exclusivement par notre portail d'applications en ligne. Les demandes par courriel ou par la poste ne seront pas prises en considération.

La date limite de présentation de la demande est le 31 janvier 2027. Les présentations incomplètes ne seront pas prises en considération. Le calendrier est le suivant :

•
Jusqu'au 31 janvier 2027: Les candidats doivent soumettre leur demande, après la présélection initiale, les dossiers de demande admissibles sont envoyés aux chaires correspondantes et après des évaluations internes et des entrevues, chaque chaire peut choisir leur candidat pour la liste restreinte.

•
mi-mars 2027 : Les candidats présélectionnés sont invités à une entrevue en ligne avec tous les professeurs participants

•
Dernières avant le 1er avril 2027: Les candidats sont informés du résultat du processus de demande

Lors du téléchargement des documents demandés, choisissez les types de pièces jointes suivants :
• Pour une lettre de présentation, sélectionnez « Lettre de couverture »
• Pour un curriculum vitae, sélectionnez « CV »
• Pour un énoncé de recherche, sélectionnez « Autre » et ajoutez le commentaire « Énoncé de recherche » (sans citations)
• Pour un portefeuille d'échantillons de travail, sélectionnez « Dossier de demande »

Veuillez ne pas joindre de documents supplémentaires, en particulier des scans de passeport/ID, des dossiers scolaires et des lettres de recommandation (ils sont traités séparément).

À propos d'ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich est l'une des principales universités du monde spécialisées dans
science et technologie. Nous sommes réputés pour notre excellente éducation,
recherche fondamentale de pointe et transfert direct de nouvelles connaissances
dans la société. Plus de 30 000 personnes de plus de 120 pays trouvent notre
l'université d'être un lieu qui favorise la pensée indépendante et un
un environnement qui inspire l'excellence. Situé au cœur de l'Europe,
Nous travaillons ensemble pour
développer des solutions aux défis mondiaux d'aujourd'hui et de demain.

jobs.description:
Doctoral Position in High Intensity Electron Sources for Future Accelerators

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

Our research group, based at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), explores new technologies for future accelerator facilities. Through the development of new technologies and techniques, we develop high intensity particle sources, high gradient particle accelerators and beam diagnostics systems that measure beam qualities down to the sub-femtosecond regime. Our research combines beam/plasma physics, unique RF technologies and high-power lasers to realise the accelerators that exist within the Paul Scherrer Institute and reaching beyond with contributions to CERN’s future circular collider (FCC).

This Doctoral Position will be based at PSI Villigen but with teaching assistant duties at ETH Zurich.

Project background

The project involves developing electron sources for future accelerator facilities at PSI and the institute’s contributions to the FCC. A central shared challenge is shaping the electron beam as it is generated or shortly afterward. For the FCC, precise control of the laser profile in the RF photogun enables the flexible filling schemes needed for top-up operation. For X-ray free-electron lasers, like SwissFEL, transverse laser shaping and early RF compression are key to producing brighter electron beams. This PhD project will advance beam-shaping techniques for both applications.

Job description
• Commission a new electron source test stand and demonstrate pulse-to-pulse modulation of bunch charge, beam size, and laser pulse energy relevant to the FCC-ee electron source concept
• Compare laser-shaping techniques through beam measurements, build a prototype for photocathode operation, and investigate machine-learning/AI-based optimization to improve performance
• Study photocathode and laser performance, including the lifetime of semiconductor photocathodes at bunch charges of up to 5 nC
• Measure gains in beam brightness from both photocathode laser shaping and RF compression with applications to a SwissFEL upgrade (SwissFEL+)

Profile
• Master’s degree (or equivalent) in physics, accelerator science, electrical engineering, photonics, or a closely related field
• Strong interest in accelerator physics, electron sources and experimental work; experience with beam dynamics, lasers/optics, numerical modelling or scientific programming is an advantage
• A practical, independent and analytical working style, combined with enthusiasm for interdisciplinary collaboration
• Professional proficiency in English; knowledge of German is an asset

We offer

We are a dynamic, interdisciplinary research group committed to innovation and collaboration. As a Doctoral student with us, you will benefit from comprehensive on-the-job training alongside a wide range of personal and professional development opportunities. We are strongly committed to vocational training and to supporting your growth both as a scientist and as a professional.

We value work-life balance and offer modern employment conditions with on-site infrastructure designed to give you the flexibility to accommodate your personal interests and family commitments.

As part of our team, you will have access to:
• A stimulating research environment combining fundamental beam physics, laser physics, and RF technology development, with hands-on practical experience in designing, commissioning, and operating particle accelerators
• A broad range of transferable skills with applications in both academic research and industry
• State-of-the-art instruments and fully operational accelerator facilities
• Large-scale, multidisciplinary projects that build teamwork and collaboration competencies across a wide range of scientific and engineering interfaces
• Enrollment in the ETH Doctoral Programme
• Teaching and mentoring opportunities

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application in the format of a single, merged PDF document in the following order:
• Cover letter detailing your research motivation, interests, and experience
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Academic transcripts of all degrees in English (Bachelor's and Master's)
• Three professional reference contacts, including an email and a direct phone number to reach them
• A publication or thesis work sampling your academic reasoning and writing
• Name the PDF with your last name and initials as well as the application date (for example, 20251110_DoeJane_application)

Further information about Paul Scherrer Institute Accelerator Center can be found on our website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr. Thomas Lucas, Thomas.lucas@psi.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

About ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in
science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education,
cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge
into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our
university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an
environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe,
yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to
develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione dottorale in sorgenti di elettroni ad alta intensità per acceleratori futuri

100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato

Il nostro gruppo di ricerca, con sede presso il Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), esplora le nuove tecnologie per i futuri impianti di acceleratore. Attraverso lo sviluppo di nuove tecnologie e tecniche, sviluppiamo fonti di particelle ad alta intensità, acceleratori di particelle ad alta pendenza e sistemi di diagnostica del fascio che misurano qualità del fascio fino al regime sub-femtosecondo. La nostra ricerca combina la fisica del raggio/plasma, le tecnologie RF uniche e i laser ad alta potenza per realizzare gli acceleratori che esistono all’interno dell’Istituto Paul Scherrer e raggiungere oltre i contributi al futuro collider circolare del CERN (FCC).

Questa Posizione Dottorale si baserà a PSI Villigen ma con incarichi di assistente all'ETH di Zurigo.

Sfondo del progetto

Il progetto prevede lo sviluppo di fonti di elettroni per i futuri impianti di acceleratore a PSI e i contributi dell’istituto alla FCC. Una sfida condivisa centrale sta plasmando il fascio di elettroni come viene generato o poco dopo. Per la FCC, il controllo preciso del profilo laser nel fotogun RF consente i sistemi di riempimento flessibili necessari per il funzionamento superiore. Per i laser a raggi X free-electron, come SwissFEL, la modellazione laser trasversale e la compressione RF precoce sono fondamentali per produrre raggi elettroni più luminosi. Questo progetto PhD avanzerà le tecniche di trave per entrambe le applicazioni.

Descrizione del lavoro
• Commissione un nuovo stand di prova di sorgente di elettroni e dimostrare la modulazione di impulso di carica del grappolo, dimensione del fascio e l'energia del polso laser relativa al concetto di sorgente di elettroni FCC-e
• Confrontare le tecniche di modellazione laser attraverso le misurazioni del fascio, costruire un prototipo per il funzionamento del fotocathode, e indagare l'ottimizzazione basata su machine-learning/AI per migliorare le prestazioni
• Studio fotocathode e prestazioni laser, tra cui la vita di fotocathodes semiconduttore a spese di mazzo fino a 5 nC
• Misura i guadagni di luminosità del fascio sia da fotocathode modellazione laser e compressione RF con applicazioni ad un aggiornamento SwissFEL (SwissFEL+)

Profilo
• Laurea magistrale (o equivalente) in fisica, scienza acceleratore, ingegneria elettrica, fotonica, o un campo strettamente correlato
• Forte interesse per la fisica dell'acceleratore, le fonti di elettroni e il lavoro sperimentale; l'esperienza con dinamiche del fascio, laser/ottica, modellazione numerica o programmazione scientifica è un vantaggio
• Uno stile di lavoro pratico, indipendente e analitico, combinato con entusiasmo per la collaborazione interdisciplinare
• La competenza professionale in inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco è un bene

Offriamo

Siamo un gruppo di ricerca dinamico e interdisciplinare impegnato in innovazione e collaborazione. Come uno studente di dottorato con noi, trarrete vantaggio da una formazione completa on-the-job insieme a una vasta gamma di opportunità di sviluppo personale e professionale. Siamo fortemente impegnati nella formazione professionale e nel sostenere la vostra crescita sia come scienziato che come professionista.

Apprezziamo l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e offriamo condizioni di lavoro moderne con infrastrutture in loco progettate per offrirti la flessibilità di soddisfare i tuoi interessi personali e gli impegni familiari.

Nell'ambito del nostro team, avrai accesso a:
• Un ambiente di ricerca stimolante che unisce fisica del fascio fondamentale, fisica laser e sviluppo tecnologico RF, con esperienza pratica pratica nella progettazione, messa in servizio e acceleratori di particelle operative
• Una vasta gamma di competenze trasferibili con applicazioni sia nella ricerca accademica che nell'industria
• Strumenti all'avanguardia e impianti di acceleratore completamente operativi
• Progetti multidisciplinari su larga scala che costruiscono competenze di lavoro di squadra e collaborazione in una vasta gamma di interfacce scientifiche e ingegneristiche
• Iscrizione al Programma Dottorato ETH
• Opportunità di insegnamento e di mentoring

Apprezziamo la diversità e la sostenibilità

In linea con i nostri valori, ETH Zurich incoraggia una cultura inclusiva. Promuoviamo l'uguaglianza di opportunità, la diversità di valore e nutrire un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento in cui i diritti e la dignità di tutto il nostro staff e gli studenti sono rispettati. Visita il nostro sito web Equal Opportunities and Diversity per scoprire come garantiamo un ambiente equo e aperto che permetta a tutti di crescere e fiorire. La sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale per noi – stiamo costantemente lavorando verso un futuro neutro dal clima.

Curioso? Anche noi.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione online nel formato di un singolo documento PDF unito nel seguente ordine:
• lettera di copertura che dettaglia la vostra motivazione di ricerca, interessi ed esperienza
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Trascrizioni accademiche di tutti i gradi in inglese (Bachelor's e Masters)
• Tre contatti professionali di riferimento, tra cui una e-mail e un numero di telefono diretto per raggiungerli
• Un lavoro di pubblicazione o tesi che campiona il tuo ragionamento accademico e la scrittura

Doctoral Position in High Intensity Electron Sources for Future Accelerators

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

Our research group, based at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), explores new technologies for future accelerator facilities. Through the development of new technologies and techniques, we develop high intensity particle sources, high gradient particle accelerators and beam diagnostics systems that measure beam qualities down to the sub-femtosecond regime. Our research combines beam/plasma physics, unique RF technologies and high-power lasers to realise the accelerators that exist within the Paul Scherrer Institute and reaching beyond with contributions to CERN’s future circular collider (FCC).

This Doctoral Position will be based at PSI Villigen but with teaching assistant duties at ETH Zurich.

Project background

The project involves developing electron sources for future accelerator facilities at PSI and the institute’s contributions to the FCC. A central shared challenge is shaping the electron beam as it is generated or shortly afterward. For the FCC, precise control of the laser profile in the RF photogun enables the flexible filling schemes needed for top-up operation. For X-ray free-electron lasers, like SwissFEL, transverse laser shaping and early RF compression are key to producing brighter electron beams. This PhD project will advance beam-shaping techniques for both applications.

Job description
• Commission a new electron source test stand and demonstrate pulse-to-pulse modulation of bunch charge, beam size, and laser pulse energy relevant to the FCC-ee electron source concept
• Compare laser-shaping techniques through beam measurements, build a prototype for photocathode operation, and investigate machine-learning/AI-based optimization to improve performance
• Study photocathode and laser performance, including the lifetime of semiconductor photocathodes at bunch charges of up to 5 nC
• Measure gains in beam brightness from both photocathode laser shaping and RF compression with applications to a SwissFEL upgrade (SwissFEL+)

Profile
• Master’s degree (or equivalent) in physics, accelerator science, electrical engineering, photonics, or a closely related field
• Strong interest in accelerator physics, electron sources and experimental work; experience with beam dynamics, lasers/optics, numerical modelling or scientific programming is an advantage
• A practical, independent and analytical working style, combined with enthusiasm for interdisciplinary collaboration
• Professional proficiency in English; knowledge of German is an asset

100%, Zürich, befristet

Unsere Forschungsgruppe am Paul Scherrer Institut (PSI) erforscht neue Technologien für zukünftige Beschleunigeranlagen. Durch die Entwicklung neuer Technologien und Techniken entwickeln wir hochintensive Teilchenquellen, Teilchenbeschleuniger mit hohem Gradienten und Strahldiagnostiksysteme, die Strahlqualitäten bis ins Sub-Femtosekunden-Regime messen. Unsere Forschung kombiniert Strahl-/Plasmaphysik, einzigartige HF-Technologien und Hochleistungslaser, um die Beschleuniger zu realisieren, die innerhalb des Paul Scherrer Instituts existieren und die mit Beiträgen zum zukünftigen CERN-Circular Collider (FCC) darüber hinausreichen.

Diese Doktorandenstelle wird am PSI Villigen angesiedelt sein, jedoch mit Lehrassistenzaufgaben an der ETH Zürich.

Projekthintergrund

Das Projekt umfasst die Entwicklung von Elektronenquellen für zukünftige Beschleunigeranlagen am PSI und die Beiträge des Instituts zur FCC. Eine zentrale gemeinsame Herausforderung besteht darin, den Elektronenstrahl so zu gestalten, wie er erzeugt wird oder kurz danach. Für die FCC ermöglicht eine präzise Steuerung des Laserprofils in der HF-Photogun die flexiblen Füllschemata, die für den Auffüllbetrieb erforderlich sind. Für Freie-Elektronen-Röntgenlaser wie SwissFEL sind transversale Laserformung und frühe HF-Kompression der Schlüssel zur Erzeugung hellerer Elektronenstrahlen. Dieses PhD-Projekt wird die Strahlformungstechniken für beide Anwendungen voranbringen.

Stellenbeschreibung
• Beauftragen Sie einen neuen Elektronenquellen-Prüfstand und demonstrieren Sie die Puls-zu-Puls-Modulation von Bündelladung, Strahlgröße und Laserpulsenergie, die für das FCC-ee-Elektronenquellenkonzept relevant sind
• Vergleichen Sie Laserformungstechniken durch Strahlmessungen, bauen Sie einen Prototyp für den Photokathodenbetrieb und untersuchen Sie die maschinelle Lern- / KI-basierte Optimierung, um die Leistung zu verbessern
• Untersuchung der Photokathode und der Laserleistung, einschließlich der Lebensdauer von Halbleiter-Photokathoden bei Bündelladungen von bis zu 5 nC
• Messen Sie die Steigerung der Strahlhelligkeit sowohl durch Photokathodenlaserformung als auch durch HF-Kompression mit Anwendungen für ein SwissFEL-Upgrade (SwissFEL+)

Grâce au développement de nouvelles technologies et techniques, nous développons des sources de particules de haute intensité, des accélérateurs de particules à gradient élevé et des systèmes de diagnostic de faisceau qui mesurent les qualités du faisceau jusqu'au régime de la sous-femtoseconde. Nos recherches combinent la physique du faisceau/plasma, des technologies RF uniques et des lasers de grande puissance pour réaliser les accélérateurs qui existent au sein de l'Institut Paul Scherrer et aller au-delà avec des contributions au futur collider circulaire du CERN.

Ce poste de doctorat sera basé à PSI Villigen mais avec des fonctions d'assistant d'enseignement à l'ETH Zurich.

Contexte du projet

Le projet consiste à mettre au point des sources d'électrons pour les installations d'accélérateur à l'ISP et les contributions de l'institut à la FCC. Un défi central partagé consiste à façonner le faisceau d'électrons tel qu'il est généré ou peu après. Pour le FCC, le contrôle précis du profil laser dans le photogun RF permet les schémas de remplissage flexibles nécessaires pour le fonctionnement complémentaire. Pour les lasers à rayons X, comme SwissFEL, la mise au point de lasers transverses et la compression RF précoce sont essentielles pour produire des faisceaux d'électrons plus brillants. Ce projet de doctorat fera progresser les techniques de façonnage des faisceaux pour les deux applications.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Exoplanet Atmosphere Characterisation and the Search for Life

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher to work on the atmospheric characterisation of temperate terrestrial exoplanets and the search for life within the Exoplanets and Habitability Group led by Prof. Sascha P. Quanz at ETH Zurich. The two-year position is embedded in the NCCR Genesis, the National Centre of Competence in Research on the emergence of life in the Universe , and closely connected to the ETH-led LIFE space mission . LIFE is a space-based mid-infrared nulling interferometer to directly detect and spectroscopically characterise dozens of temperate terrestrial exoplanets around nearby stars. The successful candidate will join the LIFE Science Team and work closely with researchers and students at ETH Zurich and across the wider LIFE collaboration.

Project background

A central goal of LIFE is to characterise the atmospheres of temperate terrestrial exoplanets and ultimately assess their habitability and possible signs of life. Understanding which atmospheric properties can be robustly inferred from mid-infrared observations is also essential for translating LIFE's science goals into science requirements and corresponding instrument-performance requirements.

Our group has developed the atmospheric retrieval framework pyRetLIFE and has so far investigated mainly Earth-like planets and classical atmospheric biosignature gases. An important next step is to broaden this work towards the diversity of potentially habitable and inhabited worlds: different atmospheric compositions and climates, non-Earth-like biospheres, non-standard biosignatures, and the abiotic scenarios against which potential signs of life need to be interpreted.

While atmospheric retrievals might be an important starting point, the project may also involve complementary atmospheric modelling or alternative inference approaches, including machine learning and AI. Possible focus points for personal research performed by the successful applicant include (but are not restricted to) how to characterise diverse planetary atmospheres, how to distinguish biological interpretations from plausible abiotic alternatives, and how these results can inform the science and instrument requirements of LIFE.

Job description
• Develop and pursue research on the characterisation of temperate terrestrial exoplanet atmospheres and the search for signs of life in the context of the LIFE mission
• Investigate atmospheric scenarios beyond modern Earth analogues; this may include non-Earth-like biospheres, non-standard biosignatures and/or relevant abiotic alternatives
• Use and further develop atmospheric retrieval and/or complementary modelling and inference approaches, potentially including ML/AI methods
• In close collaboration with the LIFE Science Team and LIFE Instrument Science Team, translate atmospheric-characterisation results into science requirements and related instrument-performance requirements for LIFE
• Contribute new scientific ideas to the development of the LIFE science case and interact with the broader LIFE collaboration
• Work closely with and provide scientific mentoring to PhD and undergraduate students pursuing related projects

Profile
• PhD in astrophysics, planetary science, atmospheric science, physics or a closely related field, completed by the start date
• Experience with atmospheric retrievals and a strong background in exoplanet atmospheric modelling and characterisation
• Good understanding of the major scientific questions surrounding exoplanet habitability, biosignatures and the search for life
• Strong scientific programming skills; experience with radiative-transfer, photochemical, climate or general-circulation models is welcome
• Experience with machine-learning or AI approaches for atmospheric inference is welcome but not required
• Ability and interest to work across disciplinary boundaries and interact with the broader exoplanet, atmospheric-science and astrobiology communities
• Willingness to work closely with PhD and undergraduate students and provide scientific mentoring and guidance on their research projects
• Scientific independence, curiosity and a collaborative approach to research

We offer
• A collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment within the Exoplanets and Habitability Group and the LIFE Space Mission team at ETH Zurich, with close links to the international LIFE collaboration
• An active community within the NCCR Genesis, spanning astrophysics, planetary science, geochemistry, chemistry and biology
• Competitive salary and benefits according to ETH regulations, with support for conference travel, computing and career development
• An initial appointment for two years with the possibility of an extension depending on performance and funding

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Further information about our group can be found on our Website . Questions regarding the position and informal enquiries are welcome and should be directed to Prof. Sascha Quanz, sascha.quanz@phys.ethz.ch (no applications). Ricercatore post-dottorato in Ambiente Exoplanet Caratterizzazione e ricerca della vita

100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato

Stiamo cercando un ricercatore post-dottorato di lavorare sulla caratterizzazione atmosferica di esopianeti terrestri temperati e sulla ricerca della vita all'interno del gruppo Exoplanets e Habitability guidato dal Prof. Sascha P. Quanz all'ETH Zurich. La posizione di due anni è incorporata nella Genesi NCCR, il Centro Nazionale di Competenza nella Ricerca sull'emergere della vita nell'Universo , e strettamente collegata alla missione spaziale LIFE guidata dalla ETH. LIFE è un interferometro nullo a metà infrarosso basato sullo spazio per rilevare e spettroscopicamente caratterizzare decine di esopiani terrestri temperati intorno alle stelle vicine. Il candidato di successo si unirà al LIFE Science Team e lavorerà a stretto contatto con ricercatori e studenti dell'ETH di Zurigo e attraverso la più ampia collaborazione LIFE.

Sfondo del progetto

Un obiettivo centrale di LIFE è quello di caratterizzare le atmosfere di esopianeti terrestri temperati e, infine, valutare la loro abitabilità e i possibili segni di vita. Comprendere quali proprietà atmosferiche possono essere saldamente deferite da osservazioni intermedie è anche essenziale per tradurre gli obiettivi scientifici di LIFE in requisiti scientifici e corrispondenti requisiti di prestazioni degli strumenti.

Il nostro gruppo ha sviluppato il piyRetLIFE del quadro di recupero atmosferico e ha finora indagato principalmente pianeti simili alla Terra e gas di biodisegnatura atmosferica classici. Un importante passo successivo è quello di ampliare questo lavoro verso la diversità dei mondi potenzialmente abitabili e abitati: composizioni e climi atmosferici differenti, biosfera non-Terra, biosignature non standard e scenari abiotici contro i quali devono essere interpretati i potenziali segni di vita.

Mentre il recupero atmosferico potrebbe essere un punto di partenza importante, il progetto può anche coinvolgere approcci complementari di modellazione atmosferica o di inferenza alternativa, tra cui l'apprendimento automatico e l'intelligenza artificiale. Possibili punti di riferimento per la ricerca personale eseguita dal richiedente di successo includono (ma non sono limitati a) come caratterizzare diverse atmosfere planetarie, come distinguere interpretazioni biologiche da alternative abiotici plausibili, e come questi risultati possono informare i requisiti di scienza e strumento di LIFE.

Descrizione del lavoro

• Indagare scenari atmosferici al di là degli analoghi moderni della Terra; ciò può includere biosfera non-Earth, biosignature non standard e/o alternative abiotiche rilevanti
• Utilizzare e sviluppare ulteriormente il recupero atmosferico e/o approcci di modellazione e inferenza complementari, potenzialmente compresi i metodi ML/AI

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con e fornire mentoring scientifico a dottorandi e studenti universitari che perseguono progetti correlati

Profilo

descriptionByLocale.en:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Exoplanet Atmosphere Characterisation and the Search for Life

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher to work on the atmospheric characterisation of temperate terrestrial exoplanets and the search for life within the Exoplanets and Habitability Group led by Prof. Sascha P. Quanz at ETH Zurich. The two-year position is embedded in the NCCR Genesis, the National Centre of Competence in Research on the emergence of life in the Universe , and closely connected to the ETH-led LIFE space mission . LIFE is a space-based mid-infrared nulling interferometer to directly detect and spectroscopically characterise dozens of temperate terrestrial exoplanets around nearby stars. The successful candidate will join the LIFE Science Team and work closely with researchers and students at ETH Zurich and across the wider LIFE collaboration.

Project background

A central goal of LIFE is to characterise the atmospheres of temperate terrestrial exoplanets and ultimately assess their habitability and possible signs of life. Understanding which atmospheric properties can be robustly inferred from mid-infrared observations is also essential for translating LIFE's science goals into science requirements and corresponding instrument-performance requirements.

Our group has developed the atmospheric retrieval framework pyRetLIFE and has so far investigated mainly Earth-like planets and classical atmospheric biosignature gases. An important next step is to broaden this work towards the diversity of potentially habitable and inhabited worlds: different atmospheric compositions and climates, non-Earth-like biospheres, non-standard biosignatures, and the abiotic scenarios against which potential signs of life need to be interpreted.

While atmospheric retrievals might be an important starting point, the project may also involve complementary atmospheric modelling or alternative inference approaches, including machine learning and AI. Possible focus points for personal research performed by the successful applicant include (but are not restricted to) how to characterise diverse planetary atmospheres, how to distinguish biological interpretations from plausible abiotic alternatives, and how these results can inform the science and instrument requirements of LIFE.

Job description
• Develop and pursue research on the characterisation of temperate terrestrial exoplanet atmospheres and the search for signs of life in the context of the LIFE mission
• Investigate atmospheric scenarios beyond modern Earth analogues; this may include non-Earth-like biospheres, non-standard biosignatures and/or relevant abiotic alternatives
• Use and further develop atmospheric retrieval and/or complementary modelling and inference approaches, potentially including ML/AI methods
• In close collaboration with the LIFE Science Team and LIFE Instrument Science Team, translate atmospheric-characterisation results into science requirements and related instrument-performance requirements for LIFE
• Contribute new scientific ideas to the development of the LIFE science case and interact with the broader LIFE collaboration
• Work closely with and provide scientific mentoring to PhD and undergraduate students pursuing related projects

Profile
• PhD in astrophysics, planetary science, atmospheric science, physics or a closely related field, completed by the start date
• Experience with atmospheric retrievals and a strong background in exoplanet atmospheric modelling and characterisation
• Good understanding of the major scientific questions surrounding exoplanet habitability, biosignatures and the search for life
• Strong scientific programming skills; experience with radiative-transfer, photochemical, climate or general-circulation models is welcome
• Experience with machine-learning or AI approaches for atmospheric inference is welcome but not required
• Ability and interest to work across disciplinary boundaries and interact with the broader exoplanet, atmospheric-science and astrobiology communities
• Willingness to work closely with PhD and undergraduate students and provide scientific mentoring and guidance on their research projects
• Scientific independence, curiosity and a collaborative approach to research

We offer
• A collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment within the Exoplanets and Habitability Group and the LIFE Space Mission team at ETH Zurich, with close links to the international LIFE collaboration
• An active community within the NCCR Genesis, spanning astrophysics, planetary science, geochemistry, chemistry and biology
• Competitive salary and benefits according to ETH regulations, with support for conference travel, computing and career development
• An initial appointment for two years with the possibility of an extension depending on performance and funding

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents combined into a single PDF:
• A CV including a publication list
• A statement of research interests (max. 2 page), including your own ideas for the project
• Names and contact details of three referees

Further information about our group can be found on our Website . Questions regarding the position and informal enquiries are welcome and should be directed to Prof. Sascha Quanz, sascha.quanz@phys.ethz.ch (no applications). Please note that applications must be submitted exclusively through our online application portal; applications sent by email or post will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

The deadline for applications is November 15, 2026. The start date is flexible but can be as early as March/April 2027.

science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education,
cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge
into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our
university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an
environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe,
yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to
develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

Postdoktorand in Exoplaneten-Atmosphärencharakterisierung und der Suche nach Leben

100%, Zürich, befristet

Wir suchen einen Postdoktoranden, der sich mit der atmosphärischen Charakterisierung von terrestrischen Exoplaneten und der Suche nach Leben innerhalb der Exoplaneten- und Habitability-Gruppe unter der Leitung von Prof. Dr. Prof. Sascha P. Quanz an der ETH Zürich. Die zweijährige Position ist im NFS Genesis, dem Nationalen Forschungszentrum zur Entstehung des Lebens im Universum, eingebettet und eng mit der von der ETH geleiteten Weltraummission LIFE verbunden. LIFE ist ein weltraumgestütztes Mittelinfrarot-Nullpunkt-Interferometer, um Dutzende von gemäßigten terrestrischen Exoplaneten um nahegelegene Sterne direkt zu erkennen und spektroskopisch zu charakterisieren. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird dem LIFE Science Team beitreten und eng mit Forschern und Studierenden der ETH Zürich und der weiteren LIFE-Zusammenarbeit zusammenarbeiten.

Projekthintergrund

Ein zentrales Ziel von LIFE ist es, die Atmosphären von gemäßigten terrestrischen Exoplaneten zu charakterisieren und letztendlich ihre Bewohnbarkeit und mögliche Lebenszeichen zu bewerten. Zu verstehen, welche atmosphärischen Eigenschaften robust aus mittleren Infrarot-Beobachtungen abgeleitet werden können, ist auch wichtig, um die wissenschaftlichen Ziele von LIFE in wissenschaftliche Anforderungen und entsprechende Leistungsanforderungen an Instrumente zu übersetzen.

Unsere Gruppe hat das atmosphärische Retrieval Framework pyRetLIFE entwickelt und bisher hauptsächlich erdähnliche Planeten und klassische atmosphärische Biosignaturgase untersucht. Ein wichtiger nächster Schritt besteht darin, diese Arbeit auf die Vielfalt potenziell bewohnbarer und bewohnter Welten auszudehnen: unterschiedliche atmosphärische Zusammensetzungen und Klimazonen, nicht-erdähnliche Biosphären, Nicht-Standard-Biosignaturen und die abiotischen Szenarien, gegen die potenzielle Lebenszeichen interpretiert werden müssen.

Während atmosphärische Abrufe ein wichtiger Ausgangspunkt sein könnten, könnte das Projekt auch komplementäre atmosphärische Modelle oder alternative Inferenzansätze umfassen, einschließlich maschinellem Lernen und KI. Mögliche Schwerpunkte für die persönliche Forschung des erfolgreichen Antragstellers sind (aber nicht beschränkt auf) die Charakterisierung verschiedener planetarer Atmosphären, die Unterscheidung biologischer Interpretationen von plausiblen abiotischen Alternativen und wie diese Ergebnisse die wissenschaftlichen und instrumentellen Anforderungen von LIFE beeinflussen können.

Stellenbeschreibung
• Entwicklung und Fortsetzung der Forschung zur Charakterisierung terrestrischer Atmosphären von Exoplaneten in gemäßigten Temperaturen und zur Suche nach Lebenszeichen im Rahmen der LIFE-Mission
• Untersuchen Sie atmosphärische Szenarien jenseits moderner Erdanaloga; dies kann nicht-erdähnliche Biosphären, Nicht-Standard-Biosignaturen und / oder relevante abiotische Alternativen umfassen.
• Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung von Ansätzen für atmosphärisches Abrufen und/oder ergänzende Modellierung und Inferenz, möglicherweise einschließlich ML/AI-Methoden
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem LIFE-Wissenschaftsteam und dem LIFE-Instrumenten-Wissenschaftsteam Umsetzung der Ergebnisse der atmosphärischen Charakterisierung in wissenschaftliche Anforderungen und damit verbundene Leistungsanforderungen für LIFE-Instrumente
• Beitrag neuer wissenschaftlicher Ideen zur Entwicklung des LIFE-Wissenschaftsfalls und Interaktion mit der breiteren LIFE-Zusammenarbeit
• Eng zusammenarbeiten und wissenschaftliche Mentoring für Doktoranden und Studenten zur Verfügung stellen, die verwandte Projekte verfolgen

Profil
• PhD in Astrophysik, Planetenwissenschaft, Atmosphärenwissenschaft, Physik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich, abgeschlossen bis zum Startdatum
• Erfahrung mit atmosphärischen Abrufungen und einem starken Hintergrund in der Modellierung und Charakterisierung von Exoplaneten
• Gutes Verständnis der wichtigsten wissenschaftlichen Fragen rund um die Bewohnbarkeit von Exoplaneten, Biosignaturen und die Suche nach Leben
• Starke wissenschaftliche Programmierkenntnisse; Erfahrungen mit Strahlungsübertragungs-, Photochemie-, Klima- oder allgemeinen Zirkulationsmodellen sind willkommen
• Erfahrung mit maschinellem Lernen oder KI-Ansätzen für atmosphärische Inferenz ist willkommen, aber nicht erforderlich
• Fähigkeit und Interesse, über disziplinäre Grenzen hinweg zu arbeiten und mit den breiteren Exoplaneten-, Atmosphären- und Astrobiologiegemeinschaften zu interagieren
• Bereitschaft, eng mit Doktoranden und Studenten zusammenzuarbeiten und wissenschaftliche Beratung und Anleitung für ihre Forschungsprojekte bereitzustellen
• Wissenschaftliche Unabhängigkeit, Neugier und ein kooperativer Forschungsansatz

Wir bieten
• Ein kollaboratives und interdisziplinäres Forschungsumfeld innerhalb der Exoplanets and Habitability Group und des LIFE Space Mission Teams an der ETH Zürich mit engen Verbindungen zur internationalen LIFE-Kooperation

Chercheur postdoctoral en caractérisation de l'atmosphère exoplanète et recherche de la vie

100%, Zurich, durée déterminée

Nous cherchons un chercheur postdoctoral pour travailler sur la caractérisation atmosphérique des exoplanètes terrestres tempérées et sur la recherche de la vie au sein du Groupe Exoplanètes et Habitabilité dirigé par le Prof. Sascha P. Quanz à l'ETH Zurich. La position de deux ans est ancrée dans le NCCR Genesis, le Centre National de Compétence en Recherche sur l'émergence de la vie dans l'Univers, et étroitement liée à la mission spatiale LIFE dirigée par l'ETH. LIFE est un interféromètre d'effacement à infrarouge intermédiaire basé dans l'espace pour détecter directement et caractériser spectroscopiquement des dizaines d'exoplanètes terrestres tempérées autour des étoiles voisines. Le candidat retenu se joindra à l'équipe scientifique LIFE et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les chercheurs et les étudiants de l'ETH de Zurich et dans le cadre de la collaboration LIFE.

Contexte du projet

Un objectif central de LIFE est de caractériser les atmosphères des exoplanètes terrestres tempérées et d'évaluer en fin de compte leur habitabilité et les signes possibles de vie. Il est également essentiel de comprendre quelles propriétés atmosphériques peuvent être fortement déduites des observations à mi-infrarouge pour traduire les objectifs scientifiques de LIFE en exigences scientifiques et en exigences correspondantes en matière de performance des instruments.

Notre groupe a développé le cadre de récupération atmosphérique pyRetLIFE et a jusqu'à présent étudié principalement des planètes semblables à la Terre et des gaz de biosignature atmosphérique classiques. Une étape importante est d'élargir ce travail à la diversité des mondes potentiellement habitables et habités : compositions et climats atmosphériques différents, biosphères non-terrestres, biosignatures non standard et scénarios abiotiques sur lesquels il faut interpréter les signes potentiels de la vie.

Bien que la récupération de l'atmosphère puisse constituer un point de départ important, le projet peut aussi comporter une modélisation atmosphérique complémentaire ou d'autres méthodes d'inférence, y compris l'apprentissage automatique et l'IA. Les points d'intérêt possibles pour la recherche personnelle effectuée par le candidat retenu comprennent (mais ne se limitent pas à) comment caractériser diverses atmosphères planétaires, comment distinguer les interprétations biologiques des alternatives abiotiques plausibles, et comment ces résultats peuvent éclairer les exigences scientifiques et instrumentales de LIFE.

Description du poste
• Développer et poursuivre les recherches sur la caractérisation des atmosphères d'exoplanète terrestre tempérée et la recherche de signes de vie dans le cadre de la mission LIFE
• Étudier les scénarios atmosphériques au-delà des analogues terrestres modernes; cela peut inclure des biosphères non terrestres, des biosignatures non standard et/ou des solutions de remplacement abiotiques pertinentes
• Utilisation et mise au point de méthodes de recherche atmosphérique et/ou de modélisation et d ' inférence complémentaires, y compris éventuellement des méthodes ML/AI
• En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe scientifique LIFE et l'équipe scientifique LIFE Instrument, traduire les résultats de la caractérisation atmosphérique en exigences scientifiques et en exigences connexes en matière de performance des instruments pour LIFE
• Contribuer de nouvelles idées scientifiques au développement du cas scientifique LIFE et interagir avec la collaboration élargie LIFE
• Collaborer étroitement avec les étudiants du doctorat et du premier cycle et fournir un mentorat scientifique à ceux qui poursuivent des projets connexes

Profil
• Doctorat en astrophysique, sciences planétaires, sciences atmosphériques, physique ou domaine étroitement apparenté, complété à la date de début
• Expérience de la récupération de l'atmosphère et d'un contexte solide dans la modélisation et la caractérisation de l'atmosphère exoplanète
• Bonne compréhension des principales questions scientifiques concernant l'habitabilité de l'exoplanète, les biosignatures et la recherche de la vie
• Fortes compétences en programmation scientifique; l'expérience des modèles de transfert radiatif, photochimique, climatique ou de circulation générale est bienvenue
• L'expérience de l'apprentissage automatique ou des approches de l'IA pour l'inférence atmosphérique est la bienvenue, mais pas requise.
• Capacité et intérêt de travailler au-delà des limites disciplinaires et d'interagir avec les communautés élargies de l'exoplanète, des sciences atmosphériques et de l'astrobiologie
• Volonté de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les étudiants de doctorat et de premier cycle et de fournir un encadrement scientifique et des conseils sur leurs projets de recherche
• Indépendance scientifique, curiosité et approche collaborative de la recherche

Nous offrons
• Un environnement de recherche collaboratif et interdisciplinaire au sein du groupe Exoplanets and Habitability et de l'équipe LIFE Space Mission à l'ETH Zurich, avec des liens étroits avec la collaboration internationale LIFE
• Une communauté active au sein du CCNR Genesis, couvrant l'astrophysique, la science planétaire, la géochimie, la chimie et la biologie
• Salaires et avantages concurrentiels selon la réglementation de l'ETH, avec soutien pour les voyages de conférence, l'informatique et le développement de carrière

Nous apprécions la diversité et la durabilité

Curieux ? Nous aussi.
