jobs.description:
Systems Engineering / Storage Engineer

80%-100%, Lugano, fixed-term

The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates cutting-edge, High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems as an essential service facility for science. The centre enables world-class research through its scientific user lab, which is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices in Lugano (headquarter) and Zurich.

Project background

With the convergence of HPC and cloud technology, supercomputing service providers like CSCS strive to improve our service portfolios that focus on large, complex, and diverse scientific and engineering applications. Effectively providing performant and capable storage systems supporting the needs of HPC platforms running on a multi-tenant infrastructure is complex and challenging engineering work.

To support these efforts, CSCS is seeking a Storage Engineer (Systems Engineering) to join our team in Lugano. The position is initially offered on a two-year contract, with the possibility of extension. This position is funded by a project that will enable scientists to benefit from large scale climate and earth observation data, and will involve collaboration with partners such as the ETHZ Geolab and C2SM, as well as international partners such as ECMWF, NASA and NOAA.

Job description

The main goal of this position is to implement and operate HPC storage services in a multi-tenant infrastructure. As a Storage Engineer you will directly contribute to the designing, implementation, maintenance, and documentation of storage services for HPC.

Your contributions will directly impact the development and enhancement of HPC systems, thereby enhancing overall system functionality and efficiency.

Profile

You have a sound knowledge of
• Linux administration skills
• Generic filesystem aspects and functions (data, metadata, block-size etc.)
• Storage redundancy technologies (RAID, D-RAID, EC etc.)
• Backup solutions (DMF, TSM, Veeam) and backup concepts
• Object Storage concepts and S3 service usage/implementation
• Automation tools and framework, including CI/CD processes and ecosystem (e.g., Gitlab CI, HashiCorp Vault)

Experience with the following is preferred, though there will be ample opportunities to learn and gain more experience with all of these skills on the job:
• Experience with parallel file systems (GPFS, Lustre)
• Experience with Ceph Storage Clusters
• Experience with versioning systems and CI/CD workflows such as ArgoCD
• Experience with physical servers automated installation systems such as OpenCHAMI, MAAS, or Foreman
• Experience with developing Ansible configurations
• Experience developing services on top of Kubernetes

You should have a bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

We offer

In an organization that values autonomy, ownership and continuous learning, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to gain specialized hands-on experience through activities characterized by the challenging aspects typical of the HPC field.

Our core values as guiding principles:
• Curiosity: You enjoy learning, exploring new ideas, and understanding problems deeply.
• Openness: You listen, collaborate, and are receptive to different perspectives.
• Courage: You tackle challenging or ambiguous problems and are willing to take initiative.
• Supportiveness: You help colleagues and users succeed and contribute to a positive team culture.
• Integrity: You act honestly, ethically, and reliably in your work.

Our culture and benefits:
• We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team and particularly encourage applications from from groups underrepresented in tech. If you are technically strong, curious, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you.
• At CSCS, being family-friendly is much more than a label. We provide flexible and supportive working conditions that help employees manage both their careers and family responsibilities. For example, one of our Lugano buildings hosts a childcare facility, and we financially support up to three weeks of summer camp for primary school children. If your child is sick and you need assistance, we will even cover the cost of in-home childcare for our Lugano based employees. We are proud to be a genuinely family-friendly employer and are committed to supporting our employees when they need it most.
• You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.
• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:
• Motivation letter in pdf
• CV in pdf
• Relevant certificates and diplomas in pdf format

We look forward to receiving your online application. Please address your application to Mrs Stephanie Frequente, CSCS Human Resources, Via Trevano 131, 6900 Lugano.

Further information about CSCS can be found on our website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Mark Klein, klein@cscs.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

For recruitment services, the GTC of ETH Zurich apply.

About ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in
science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education,
cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge
into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our
university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an
environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe,
yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to
develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ingegneria dei sistemi / Ingegnere di stoccaggio

80%-100%, Lugano, a tempo determinato

Lo Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCSCS) sviluppa e gestisce sistemi di calcolo ad alta efficienza (HPC) come un servizio essenziale per la scienza. Il centro consente la ricerca di livello mondiale attraverso il suo laboratorio di utenti scientifici, che è disponibile per i ricercatori nazionali e internazionali in accademia, industria e settore business. Il centro è gestito da ETH Zurich e ha sede a Lugano (quartiere) e Zurigo.

Sfondo del progetto

Con la convergenza della tecnologia HPC e cloud, i fornitori di servizi supercomputing come CSCS si sforzano di migliorare i nostri portafogli di servizi che si concentrano su grandi, complesse e diverse applicazioni scientifiche e ingegneristiche. Efficacemente fornire sistemi di storage performanti e capaci che supportano le esigenze delle piattaforme HPC in esecuzione su un'infrastruttura multi-tenant è complesso e impegnativo lavoro di ingegneria.

Per sostenere questi sforzi, CSCS sta cercando un ingegnere di stoccaggio (Systems Engineering) per unirsi al nostro team di Lugano. La posizione è inizialmente offerta su un contratto di due anni, con la possibilità di proroga. Questa posizione è finanziata da un progetto che consentirà agli scienziati di beneficiare di dati di osservazione del clima e della terra su larga scala, e coinvolgerà la collaborazione con partner come ETHZ Geolab e C2SM, nonché partner internazionali come ECMWF, NASA e NOAA.

Descrizione del lavoro

L'obiettivo principale di questa posizione è quello di implementare e gestire i servizi di storage HPC in un'infrastruttura multi-tenant. Come Ingegnere di Stoccaggio contribuirai direttamente alla progettazione, implementazione, manutenzione e documentazione dei servizi di storage per HPC.

I tuoi contributi influenzeranno direttamente lo sviluppo e la valorizzazione dei sistemi HPC, migliorando così la funzionalità e l'efficienza del sistema.

Profilo

Hai una solida conoscenza di
• Capacità di amministrazione Linux
• Aspetti e funzioni del filesystem generici (dati, metadati, block-size ecc.)
• Tecnologie di ridondanza di stoccaggio (RAID, D-RAID, CE ecc.)
• Soluzioni di backup (DMF, TSM, Veeam) e concetti di backup
• Concetti di stoccaggio dell'oggetto e uso/attuazione del servizio S3
• Strumenti di automazione e framework, inclusi i processi CI/CD e l'ecosistema (ad esempio, Gitlab CI, HashiCorp Vault)

L'esperienza con il seguente è preferita, anche se ci saranno ampie opportunità per imparare e acquisire più esperienza con tutte queste competenze sul lavoro:
• Esperienza con file system paralleli (GPFS, Lustre)
• Esperienza con cluster di stoccaggio Ceph
• Esperienza con sistemi di versione e flussi di lavoro CI/CD come ArgoCD
• Esperienza con server fisici sistemi di installazione automatizzati come OpenCHAMI, MAAS o Foreman
• Esperienza con lo sviluppo di configurazioni Ansible
• Esperienza di sviluppo di servizi in cima a Kubernetes

Si dovrebbe avere un diploma di laurea o superiore in Ingegneria Informatica, Scienza informatica, campo tecnico rilevante, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

Offriamo

In un'organizzazione che valorizza l'autonomia, la proprietà e l'apprendimento continuo, il candidato di successo avrà l'opportunità di acquisire esperienza pratica specializzata attraverso attività caratterizzate dagli aspetti impegnativi tipici del campo HPC.

I nostri valori fondamentali come principi guida:
• Curiosità: Ti piace imparare, esplorare nuove idee e comprendere i problemi profondamente.
• Apertura: Ascolti, collabori e sei ricettivo di prospettive diverse.
• Coraggio: affrontate problemi impegnativi o ambigui e siete disposti a prendere iniziative.
• Supportiveness: Aiuta i colleghi e gli utenti ad avere successo e a contribuire ad una cultura positiva del team.
• Integrità: Lei agisce onestamente, eticamente e in modo affidabile nel suo lavoro.

La nostra cultura e benefici:
• Ci impegniamo a costruire un team di ingegneria diversificato e inclusivo e in particolare a incoraggiare applicazioni da parte di gruppi sottorappresentati in tecnologia. Se siete tecnicamente forti, curiosi e desiderosi di crescere, vogliamo sentire da voi.
• A CSCS, essere famiglia-friendly è molto più di un'etichetta. Forniamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili e di supporto che aiutano i dipendenti a gestire sia la loro carriera che le responsabilità familiari. Ad esempio, uno dei nostri edifici di Lugano ospita una struttura per l'infanzia, e sosteniamo finanziariamente fino a tre settimane di campo estivo per i bambini delle scuole elementari. Se il vostro bambino è malato e avete bisogno di assistenza, copriremo anche il costo dell'infanzia in-home per i nostri dipendenti di Lugano. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro sinceramente familiare e ci impegniamo a sostenere i nostri dipendenti quando ne hanno più bisogno.
• Si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro emozionante, la diversità culturale e offerte interessanti e benefici.
• Il tuo lavoro con impatto: Diventa parte dell'ETH di Zurigo, che non solo supporta lo sviluppo professionale, ma contribuisce attivamente al cambiamento positivo nella società

Apprezziamo la diversità e la sostenibilità

In linea con i nostri valori, ETH Zurich incoraggia una cultura inclusiva. Promuoviamo l'uguaglianza di opportunità, la diversità di valore e nutrire un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento in cui i diritti e la dignità di tutto il nostro staff e gli studenti sono rispettati. Visita il nostro sito web Equal Opportunities and Diversity per scoprire come garantiamo un ambiente equo e aperto che permetta a tutti di crescere e fiorire. La sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale per noi – stiamo costantemente lavorando verso un futuro neutro dal clima.

Curioso? Anche noi.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua domanda online con i seguenti documenti:
• Lettera di motivazione in pdf
• CV in pdf
• Certificati e diplomi rilevanti in formato pdf

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di rivolgersi alla sua domanda alla signora Stephanie Frequente, CSCS Human Resources, Via Trevano 131, 6900 Lugano.

Ulteriori informazioni su CSCS possono essere trovate sul nostro sito web . Le domande relative alla posizione devono essere indirizzate a Mark Klein, klein@cscscs.ch (nessuna domanda).

Si prega di notare che accettiamo esclusivamente le applicazioni inviate tramite il nostro portale di applicazioni online. Le applicazioni via e-mail o servizi postali non saranno considerate.

Vorremmo sottolineare che la pre-selezione è effettuata dai reclutatori responsabili e non dall'intelligenza artificiale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Systems Engineering / Storage Engineer

80%-100%, Lugano, fixed-term

The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates cutting-edge, High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems as an essential service facility for science. The centre enables world-class research through its scientific user lab, which is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices in Lugano (headquarter) and Zurich.

Project background

With the convergence of HPC and cloud technology, supercomputing service providers like CSCS strive to improve our service portfolios that focus on large, complex, and diverse scientific and engineering applications. Effectively providing performant and capable storage systems supporting the needs of HPC platforms running on a multi-tenant infrastructure is complex and challenging engineering work.

To support these efforts, CSCS is seeking a Storage Engineer (Systems Engineering) to join our team in Lugano. The position is initially offered on a two-year contract, with the possibility of extension. This position is funded by a project that will enable scientists to benefit from large scale climate and earth observation data, and will involve collaboration with partners such as the ETHZ Geolab and C2SM, as well as international partners such as ECMWF, NASA and NOAA.

Job description

The main goal of this position is to implement and operate HPC storage services in a multi-tenant infrastructure. As a Storage Engineer you will directly contribute to the designing, implementation, maintenance, and documentation of storage services for HPC.

Your contributions will directly impact the development and enhancement of HPC systems, thereby enhancing overall system functionality and efficiency.

Profile

You have a sound knowledge of
• Linux administration skills
• Generic filesystem aspects and functions (data, metadata, block-size etc.)
• Storage redundancy technologies (RAID, D-RAID, EC etc.)
• Backup solutions (DMF, TSM, Veeam) and backup concepts
• Object Storage concepts and S3 service usage/implementation
• Automation tools and framework, including CI/CD processes and ecosystem (e.g., Gitlab CI, HashiCorp Vault)

Experience with the following is preferred, though there will be ample opportunities to learn and gain more experience with all of these skills on the job:
• Experience with parallel file systems (GPFS, Lustre)
• Experience with Ceph Storage Clusters
• Experience with versioning systems and CI/CD workflows such as ArgoCD
• Experience with physical servers automated installation systems such as OpenCHAMI, MAAS, or Foreman
• Experience with developing Ansible configurations
• Experience developing services on top of Kubernetes

You should have a bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

We offer

In an organization that values autonomy, ownership and continuous learning, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to gain specialized hands-on experience through activities characterized by the challenging aspects typical of the HPC field.

Our core values as guiding principles:
• Curiosity: You enjoy learning, exploring new ideas, and understanding problems deeply.
• Openness: You listen, collaborate, and are receptive to different perspectives.
• Courage: You tackle challenging or ambiguous problems and are willing to take initiative.
• Supportiveness: You help colleagues and users succeed and contribute to a positive team culture.
• Integrity: You act honestly, ethically, and reliably in your work.

Our culture and benefits:
• We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team and particularly encourage applications from from groups underrepresented in tech. If you are technically strong, curious, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you.
• At CSCS, being family-friendly is much more than a label. We provide flexible and supportive working conditions that help employees manage both their careers and family responsibilities. For example, one of our Lugano buildings hosts a childcare facility, and we financially support up to three weeks of summer camp for primary school children. If your child is sick and you need assistance, we will even cover the cost of in-home childcare for our Lugano based employees. We are proud to be a genuinely family-friendly employer and are committed to supporting our employees when they need it most.
• You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.
• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

80%-100%, Lugano, durée déterminée

Le Centre National de SuperComputation (CSCS) développe et exploite des systèmes de pointe de calcul haute performance (HPC) en tant que service essentiel pour la science. Ce centre permet d'effectuer des recherches de calibre mondial par l'intermédiaire de son laboratoire d'utilisateurs scientifiques, qui est accessible aux chercheurs nationaux et internationaux du milieu universitaire, de l'industrie et du secteur des affaires. Le centre est exploité par ETH Zurich et dispose de bureaux à Lugano (siège) et à Zurich.

Contexte du projet

Avec la convergence de la technologie HPC et du cloud, les fournisseurs de services supercomputants comme le CSCS s'efforcent d'améliorer nos portefeuilles de services qui se concentrent sur les applications scientifiques et techniques de grande envergure, complexes et diversifiées. La fourniture efficace de systèmes de stockage performants et capables répondant aux besoins des plates-formes de CHP fonctionnant sur une infrastructure à plusieurs locataires est un travail d'ingénierie complexe et difficile.

Pour soutenir ces efforts, le SCCS cherche un ingénieur de stockage (ingénierie des systèmes) pour rejoindre notre équipe à Lugano. Le poste est initialement offert sur un contrat de deux ans, avec possibilité de prolongation. Ce poste est financé par un projet qui permettra aux scientifiques de bénéficier de données à grande échelle sur le climat et l'observation de la Terre et qui impliquera une collaboration avec des partenaires tels que l'ETHZ Geolab et le C2SM, ainsi qu'avec des partenaires internationaux tels que l'ECMWF, la NASA et la NOAA.

Description du poste

L'objectif principal de cette position est de mettre en place et d'exploiter des services de stockage HPC dans une infrastructure à plusieurs locataires. En tant qu'ingénieur de stockage, vous contribuerez directement à la conception, la mise en œuvre, la maintenance et la documentation des services de stockage pour HPC.

Vos contributions auront une incidence directe sur le développement et l'amélioration des systèmes HPC, améliorant ainsi la fonctionnalité et l'efficacité globales du système.

Profil

Vous avez une bonne connaissance de
• Compétences en administration Linux
• Aspects et fonctions génériques du système de fichiers (données, métadonnées, taille des blocs, etc.)
• Technologies de redondance de stockage (RAID, D-RAID, EC, etc.)
• Solutions de sauvegarde (DMF, TSM, Veeam) et concepts de sauvegarde
• Concepts de stockage des objets et utilisation/mise en œuvre des services S3
• Outils et cadre d'automatisation, y compris les processus d'IC/CD et l'écosystème (p. ex. Gitlab CI, HashiCorp Vault)

On préfère l'expérience suivante, bien qu'il y ait de nombreuses possibilités d'apprendre et d'acquérir plus d'expérience avec toutes ces compétences au travail :
• Expérience des systèmes de fichiers parallèles (GPFS, Lustre)
• Expérience avec les grappes de stockage Ceph
• Expérience des systèmes de version et des flux de travail de CI/CD comme ArgoCD
• Expérience avec les systèmes d'installation automatisés de serveurs physiques tels qu'OpenCHAMI, MAAS ou Foreman
• Expérience avec le développement de configurations Ansibles
• Expérience de développement de services sur Kubernetes

Vous devriez avoir un baccalauréat ou un diplôme supérieur en génie informatique, informatique, domaine technique pertinent, ou une expérience pratique équivalente.

jobs.description:
Three Postdoctoral Positions in Circular Engineering for Architecture

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

The Chair of Circular Engineering for Architecture (CEA), led by Prof. Dr. Catherine De Wolf, is part of the Institute of Construction and Infrastructure Management (IBI) in the Department of Civil, Environmental and Geomatic Engineering (D-BAUG) at ETH Zurich. Our research focuses on digitalization towards a circular built environment, combining circular economy principles with digital innovation in construction.

We are seeking three Postdoctoral Researchers to join our team. Each will drive research within a major project and contribute to supervision and teaching at the Chair.

Project background

Position 1: Circular Construction

SWIRCULAR is a flagship Swiss project on circular construction funded by InnoSuisse and our industry partners. This position focuses on digital passports and matchmaking methods that connect reclaimed construction materials and components with new design demand.

Position 2: Circular Design

Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE) is an international collaborative project funded by the Villum Foundation. This position focuses on computer vision and generative AI for designing a sustainable, future-ready built environment. Occasional international travel is required.

Position 3: LCA

This position focuses on circularity assessment and life cycle assessment (LCA) of structures, with particular emphasis on steel, and is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF). The research examines how reusing structural elements can reduce the environmental impact of buildings and infrastructure.

All positions are offered at 100% workload.

Job description
• Conduct independent and collaborative research within your project (SWIRCULAR, CEBE, or SNSF)
• Publish results in high-impact, peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences
• Disseminate results to academic, industrial, and public audiences
• Collaborate with research and industry partners in the project consortium
• Providing scientific and methodological guidance to doctoral students
• Co-supervise Master’s and Bachelor's theses and projects
• Contribute to the Chair’s teaching, including course preparation, delivery, and student assessment

Profile
• PhD in civil engineering, architecture, computer science, or a related field
• Strong interest in sustainability and circularity in the built environment; prior experience is an advantage but not essential
• Strong record of scientific publications and conference presentations, experience in exhibitions or science communication is a plus
• Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team
• Optional: German language skills are an advantage for Position 1, to support communication with industry partners

Solid expertise in at least one of the following areas, ideally several:
• Position 1: large language models, graph theory, design optimization, advanced programming skills
• Position 2: generative AI, computer vision for information extraction, design optimization models, real options or future-ready design
• Position 3: life cycle assessment, structural design and analysis, circular design strategies such as reuse of structural elements

We offer
• A stimulating, interdisciplinary research environment at one of the world’s leading technical universities
• Involvement in projects with strong industrial relevance and societal impact, within a network of national and international partners
• Close links to architecture, structural engineering, computer science, and industry
• Opportunities to build your academic profile through publishing, teaching, and supervision
• Access to ETH Zurich’s research infrastructure, professional development courses, and mentoring programmes

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:
• Cover letter stating the position(s) you apply for (Position 1, 2, or 3), your motivation, and your research interests (max. 1 page)
• Curriculum vitae, including a list of publications

• Contact details (email adress and phone number) of at least two referees
• Optional: portfolio or selected relevant publications

Further information about the Chair of Circular Engineering for Architecture can be found on our website . Questions regarding the positions should be directed to cea-recruiting@ibi.baug.ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

La nostra ricerca si concentra sulla digitalizzazione verso un ambiente circolare costruito, combinando i principi dell'economia circolare con l'innovazione digitale nella costruzione.

Stiamo cercando tre ricercatori Postdoctoral per unirsi al nostro team. Ognuno guiderà la ricerca all'interno di un grande progetto e contribuirà alla supervisione e all'insegnamento presso la Cattedra.

Sfondo del progetto

Posizione 1: Costruzione circolare

SWIRCULAR è un progetto svizzero di punta sulla costruzione circolare finanziato da InnoSuisse e dai nostri partner del settore. Questa posizione si concentra sui passaporti digitali e sui metodi di matchmaking che collegano materiali e componenti di costruzione reclamati con una nuova domanda di design.

Posizione 2: Progettazione circolare

Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE) è un progetto di collaborazione internazionale finanziato dalla Fondazione Villum. Questa posizione si concentra sulla visione del computer e sull'intelligenza artificiale generativa per la progettazione di un ambiente costruito in futuro sostenibile. Occasionale viaggio internazionale è richiesto.

Posizione 3: LCA

Questa posizione si concentra sulla valutazione della circolarità e sulla valutazione del ciclo di vita (LCA) delle strutture, con particolare enfasi sull'acciaio, ed è finanziata dalla Fondazione svizzera per la scienza nazionale (SNSF). La ricerca esamina come riutilizzare gli elementi strutturali possa ridurre l'impatto ambientale degli edifici e delle infrastrutture.

Tutte le posizioni sono offerte al 100% di carico di lavoro.

Descrizione del lavoro

• Disseminare i risultati al pubblico accademico, industriale e pubblico

Profilo

• Forte interesse per la sostenibilità e la circolarità nell'ambiente costruito; l'esperienza precedente è un vantaggio ma non essenziale
• Forte record di pubblicazioni scientifiche e presentazioni di conferenze, l'esperienza in mostre o comunicazione scientifica è un plus

Competenze solide in almeno una delle seguenti aree, idealmente diverse:

• Posizione 2: AI generativo, visione del computer per l'estrazione delle informazioni, modelli di ottimizzazione del design, opzioni reali o design pronto per il futuro
• Posizione 3: valutazione del ciclo di vita, progettazione e analisi strutturali, strategie di progettazione circolare come il riutilizzo di elementi strutturali

Offriamo

descriptionByLocale.en:
Three Postdoctoral Positions in Circular Engineering for Architecture

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

The Chair of Circular Engineering for Architecture (CEA), led by Prof. Dr. Catherine De Wolf, is part of the Institute of Construction and Infrastructure Management (IBI) in the Department of Civil, Environmental and Geomatic Engineering (D-BAUG) at ETH Zurich. Our research focuses on digitalization towards a circular built environment, combining circular economy principles with digital innovation in construction.

We are seeking three Postdoctoral Researchers to join our team. Each will drive research within a major project and contribute to supervision and teaching at the Chair.

Project background

Position 1: Circular Construction

SWIRCULAR is a flagship Swiss project on circular construction funded by InnoSuisse and our industry partners. This position focuses on digital passports and matchmaking methods that connect reclaimed construction materials and components with new design demand.

Position 2: Circular Design

Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE) is an international collaborative project funded by the Villum Foundation. This position focuses on computer vision and generative AI for designing a sustainable, future-ready built environment. Occasional international travel is required.

Position 3: LCA

This position focuses on circularity assessment and life cycle assessment (LCA) of structures, with particular emphasis on steel, and is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF). The research examines how reusing structural elements can reduce the environmental impact of buildings and infrastructure.

All positions are offered at 100% workload.

Job description
• Conduct independent and collaborative research within your project (SWIRCULAR, CEBE, or SNSF)
• Publish results in high-impact, peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences
• Disseminate results to academic, industrial, and public audiences
• Collaborate with research and industry partners in the project consortium
• Providing scientific and methodological guidance to doctoral students
• Co-supervise Master’s and Bachelor's theses and projects
• Contribute to the Chair’s teaching, including course preparation, delivery, and student assessment

Profile
• PhD in civil engineering, architecture, computer science, or a related field
• Strong interest in sustainability and circularity in the built environment; prior experience is an advantage but not essential
• Strong record of scientific publications and conference presentations, experience in exhibitions or science communication is a plus
• Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team
• Optional: German language skills are an advantage for Position 1, to support communication with industry partners

Solid expertise in at least one of the following areas, ideally several:
• Position 1: large language models, graph theory, design optimization, advanced programming skills
• Position 2: generative AI, computer vision for information extraction, design optimization models, real options or future-ready design
• Position 3: life cycle assessment, structural design and analysis, circular design strategies such as reuse of structural elements

We offer
• A stimulating, interdisciplinary research environment at one of the world’s leading technical universities
• Involvement in projects with strong industrial relevance and societal impact, within a network of national and international partners
• Close links to architecture, structural engineering, computer science, and industry
• Opportunities to build your academic profile through publishing, teaching, and supervision
• Access to ETH Zurich’s research infrastructure, professional development courses, and mentoring programmes

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:
• Cover letter stating the position(s) you apply for (Position 1, 2, or 3), your motivation, and your research interests (max. 1 page)
• Curriculum vitae, including a list of publications
• Research statement (max. 2 pages)
• Short video (max. 2 minutes) in which you introduce yourself and present the research you would like to pursue at the Chair (please upload the video to YouTube or Vimeo (an unlisted link is sufficient) and submit the entire link in a PDF document)
• Contact details (email adress and phone number) of at least two referees
• Optional: portfolio or selected relevant publications

Further information about the Chair of Circular Engineering for Architecture can be found on our website . Questions regarding the positions should be directed to cea-recruiting@ibi.baug.ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the positions are filled. Applications in which one of the above items is missing will not be reviewed.

About ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in
science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education,
cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge
into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our
university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an
environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe,
yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to
develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

Drei Postdoc-Stellen in Circular Engineering für Architektur

100%, Zürich, befristet

Der Lehrstuhl für Circular Engineering for Architecture (CEA), geleitet von Prof. Dr. Catherine De Wolf ist Teil des Instituts für Bau- und Infrastrukturmanagement (IBI) in der Abteilung für Bau-, Umwelt- und Geomatiktechnik (D-BAUG) an der ETH Zürich. Unsere Forschung konzentriert sich auf die Digitalisierung hin zu einer zirkulären gebauten Umwelt, die Prinzipien der Kreislaufwirtschaft mit digitaler Innovation im Bauwesen kombiniert.

Wir suchen drei Postdoktoranden, die sich unserem Team anschließen. Jeder wird die Forschung innerhalb eines Großprojekts vorantreiben und zur Betreuung und Lehre am Lehrstuhl beitragen.

Projekthintergrund

Position 1: Rundbau

SWIRCULAR ist ein Schweizer Vorzeigeprojekt zum Rundbau, das von InnoSuisse und unseren Industriepartnern finanziert wird. Diese Position konzentriert sich auf digitale Pässe und Matchmaking-Methoden, die wiedergewonnene Baumaterialien und Komponenten mit neuen Designanforderungen verbinden.

Position 2: Kreisform

Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE) ist ein internationales Kooperationsprojekt, das von der Villum Foundation finanziert wird. Diese Position konzentriert sich auf Computer Vision und generative KI für die Gestaltung einer nachhaltigen, zukunftsfähigen gebauten Umgebung. Gelegentliche internationale Reisen sind erforderlich.

Position 3: LCA

Diese Position konzentriert sich auf die Circularity Assessment und Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) von Bauwerken mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf Stahl und wird vom Schweizerischen Nationalfonds (SNF) finanziert. Die Forschung untersucht, wie die Wiederverwendung von Strukturelementen die Umweltauswirkungen von Gebäuden und Infrastruktur reduzieren kann.

Alle Positionen werden zu 100% Workload angeboten.

Stellenbeschreibung

• Beitrag zur Lehre des Lehrstuhls, einschließlich Kursvorbereitung, Lieferung und Schülerbewertung

Profil

• Starke Bilanz von wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und Konferenzpräsentationen, Erfahrung in Ausstellungen oder Wissenschaftskommunikation ist ein Plus

Solide Expertise in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche, idealerweise mehrere:
• Position 1: Große Sprachmodelle, Graphentheorie, Designoptimierung, fortgeschrittene Programmierkenntnisse
• Position 2: generative KI, Computer Vision zur Informationsextraktion, Designoptimierungsmodelle, reale Optionen oder zukunftsfähiges Design

100%, Zurich, durée déterminée

La Chaire d'ingénierie circulaire pour l'architecture (CEA), dirigée par Prof. Mme Catherine De Wolf fait partie de l'Institut de la construction et de la gestion des infrastructures (IBI) du Département de génie civil, environnemental et géomatique (D-BAUG) à l'ETH Zurich. Nos recherches portent sur la numérisation vers un environnement circulaire, combinant les principes de l'économie circulaire et l'innovation numérique dans la construction.

Nous cherchons trois chercheurs postdoctoraux à rejoindre notre équipe. Chacun dirigera la recherche dans le cadre d'un grand projet et contribuera à la supervision et à l'enseignement de la chaire.

Contexte du projet

Position 1: Construction circulaire

SWIRCULAR est un projet phare suisse sur la construction circulaire financé par InnoSuisse et nos partenaires industriels. Cette position se concentre sur les passeports numériques et les méthodes d'appariement qui relient les matériaux de construction et les composants récupérés à une nouvelle demande de conception.

Position 2: Conception circulaire

Le génie civil et la transition verte dans l'environnement bâti (CEBE) est un projet de collaboration internationale financé par la Fondation Villum. Cette position se concentre sur la vision informatique et l'IA générative pour concevoir un environnement durable et prêt à l'avenir. Des voyages internationaux occasionnels sont requis.

Position 3: LCA

Cette position se concentre sur l'évaluation de la circularité et l'évaluation du cycle de vie des structures, en particulier de l'acier, et est financée par la Fondation nationale suisse des sciences (SNSF). La recherche examine comment la réutilisation des éléments structurels peut réduire l'impact environnemental des bâtiments et des infrastructures.

Tous les postes sont offerts avec une charge de travail de 100 %.

Description du poste
• Mener des recherches indépendantes et collaboratives au sein de votre projet (SWIRCULAR, CEBE ou SNSF)

Profil

• Intérêt pour la durabilité et la circonspection dans l'environnement bâti; l'expérience préalable est un avantage, mais pas essentiel
• Un bilan solide des publications scientifiques et des présentations de conférences, de l'expérience dans les expositions ou la communication scientifique est un plus
• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et capacité de travailler dans une équipe interdisciplinaire
• Optionnel: Les compétences linguistiques en allemand sont un avantage pour la position 1, pour soutenir la communication avec les partenaires de l'industrie

Une expertise solide dans au moins un des domaines suivants, idéalement plusieurs :
• Position 1: grands modèles de langage, théorie des graphiques, optimisation de la conception, compétences de programmation avancées
• Position 2: IA générative, vision informatique pour l'extraction de l'information, modèles d'optimisation de conception, options réelles ou conception future

80%-100%, Zürich, unbefristet

Zur Unterstützung von Forschung und Lehre sind die Informatikdienste der ETH Zürich als Dienstleistungsorganisation in einer grossen und komplexen IT-Umgebung tätig. Wir bieten den Angehörigen der ETH Zürich hochwertige, flexible und skalierbare Informatik-Dienstleistungen an und unterstützen sie damit im Wettbewerb mit den besten Universitäten der Welt.

In der Gruppe SAP Development entwickeln und betreiben wir gemeinsam mit dem SAP Competence Center Applikationen im SAP Back- und Frontend. Das Spektrum reicht von Backend-Lösungen für spezialisierte Nutzergruppen bis zu Webapplikationen, die ETH-weit eingesetzt werden. Ebenso integrieren wir ETH-interne wie externe Applikationen und Partner über Integrationsplattformen wie SAP Integration Suite sowie SAP PI.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine erfahrene und engagierte Persönlichkeit als Senior SAP Entwickler:in Beschaffung (MM).

Stellenbeschreibung

In dieser Funktion übernimmst Du die technische Verantwortung für SAP-Lösungen im Bereich Material Management (MM), Beschaffung und angrenzende Logistikprozesse. Du steuerst komplexe Anforderungen von der fachlichen Klärung über Lösungsarchitektur und Aufwandsschätzung bis zur Umsetzung, Einführung und nachhaltigen Betreuung. Dabei triffst Du technische Entscheidungen innerhalb der geltenden Architektur- und Governance-Vorgaben und stellst Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit, Performance und Betriebsstabilität sicher.

Du entwickelst anspruchsvolle Anwendungen und Erweiterungen im SAP Back- und Frontend mit ABAP und objektorientiertem ABAP sowie modernen Technologien wie CDS Views, OData, Fiori, SAPUI5 und RAP. Als technische Ansprechperson beurteilst Du Lösungsvarianten, definierst Zielbilder und Entwicklungsstandards und stellst sicher, dass neue Lösungen die Prinzipien von S/4HANA und Clean Core berücksichtigen.

Im laufenden Betrieb übernimmst Du Verantwortung für Wartung, Fehleranalyse, Performanceoptimierung und 3rd-Level-Support. Du dokumentierst die entwickelten Lösungen, wirkst bei der Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Entwicklungsstandards mit und stellst durch Reviews, Tests und Wissenstransfer eine nachhaltige Lösungsqualität sicher.

Du berätst Fachbereiche und das SAP Competence Center auf Augenhöhe, erkennst Abhängigkeiten zu SD, FI/CO , HCM und Integrationslösungen und entwickelst bereichsübergreifende Lösungsansätze. Durch aktiven Wissenstransfer, Coaching und fachliche Unterstützung stärkst Du das Entwicklungsteam und reduzierst Abhängigkeiten von einzelnen Personen oder externen Partnern.

Profil

Für dieses breite und abwechslungsreiche Aufgabengebiet bringst du ein hohes Mass an Selbstständigkeit und Urteilsvermögen, eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, sowie einen Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit. Ausserdem:
• Mindestens 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der SAP-Entwicklung, insbesondere mit ABAP und objektorientiertem ABAP .
• Tiefes Verständnis für Entwicklungs- und Geschäftsprozesse im SAP-Modul MM sowie Erfahrung in der digitalen Unterstützung von Beschaffungs- und Logistikprozessen.
• Routine im gesamten Entwicklungszyklus von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von Lösungen.
• Erfahrung mit SAP WebDynpro ABAP und modernen SAP-Technologien wie CDS Views, OData, Fiori Elements und RAP.
• Zusätzliche Kenntnisse in SD oder FI/CO sowie Berührungspunkte mit SAP S/4HANA sind ein Plus.
• Vorteilhaft sind Erfahrungen mit PunchOut-Integrationen auf Basis von OCI und cXML.
• Know-how in der Anbindung von Systemen über IDoc, Webservices, REST APIs oder vergleichbare Schnittstellen.
• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Anforderungen verständlich und pragmatisch umzusetzen.
• Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und die Bereitschaft, Wissen aktiv einzubringen und weiterzugeben.
• Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Zusammenarbeit in einem vielseitigen Umfeld.

Bist du flexibel, offen und teamfähig, zeigst Eigeninitiative und eine effiziente Arbeitsmethodik und hast Freude daran, zentrale SAP-Lösungen der ETH Zürich mitzugestalten? Dann möchten wir Dich gerne kennenlernen.

Wir bieten

Dein Beruf mit Wirkung: Werde Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur deine berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zu positiven Veränderungen in der Gesellschaft beiträgt.

Arbeiten beim Vizepräsidium für Infrastruktur und Nachhaltigkeit (VPIN) bedeutet, die Zukunft der ETH Zürich aktiv mitzugestalten - eine inspirierende, internationale und innovative Institution. Dein Engagement schafft beste Voraussetzungen für Exzellenz in Lehre, Forschung, Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit der ETH Zürich.

In einer offenen, inspirierenden Atmosphäre bilden Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und gegenseitiger Respekt das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch vielfältige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Bei uns erwartet dich eine sinnstiftende Arbeit in einem innovativen und wertschätzenden Umfeld, das du mitgestalten kannst und das dir neue Perspektiven eröffnet.
• An der ETH Zürich erwartet Dich ein dynamisches und internationales Umfeld
• Ein aufgestelltes, hilfsbereites offenes Team und ein moderner Arbeitsplatz
• Es erwartet Dich Gestaltungsspielraum und praxisnahe und kreative Lösungen sind sehr willkommen
• Wir leben: Lebenslanges Lernen
• Vergünstigungen wie zB ÖV-Abonnemente und Car Sharing, breites Sportangebot des ASVZ , Kinderbetreuung, attraktive Vorsorgeleistungen etc.

Diversität und Nachhaltigkeit sind uns wichtig

Im Einklang mit unseren Werten unterstützt die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit, schätzen Vielfalt und pflegen ein Arbeits- und Lernumfeld, in dem die Rechte und die Würde aller Mitarbeitenden und Studierenden respektiert werden. Auf unserer Webseite zur Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt erfahren Sie, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld sicherstellen, in dem sich alle entwickeln und entfalten können. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert – wir arbeiten konsequent an einer klimaneutralen Zukunft.

Neugierig? Sind wir auch.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Online-Bewerbung mit den folgenden Unterlagen:
• Motivationsschreiben
• Lebenslauf
• Zeugnisse

Weitere Informationen über die Informatikdienste, findest Du auf unserer Webseite . Für Auskünfte steht Markus Oswald, markus.oswald@id.ethz.ch (keine Bewerbungsunterlagen), gerne zur Verfügung.

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschliesslich über das Online-Bewerbungsportal. Bewerbungen per E-Mail sowie auf dem Postweg werden nicht berücksichtigt.

Gerne weisen wir darauf hin, dass die Vorselektion durch die verantwortlichen Rekrutierenden und nicht durch künstliche Intelligenz durchgeführt wird.

Für Personalvermittlungen gelten die AGB der ETH Zürich .

Über die ETH Zürich

Die ETH Zürich ist eine der besten technisch-naturwissenschaftlichen Hochschulen der Welt. Wir sind bekannt für unsere exzellente Lehre, wegweisende Grundlagenforschung und den direkten Transfer von neuen Erkenntnissen in die Gesellschaft. Über 30'000 Menschen aus mehr als 120 Ländern finden bei uns ein Umfeld, das eigenständiges Denken fördert, und ein Klima, das zu Spitzenleistungen inspiriert. Im Herzen Europas und weltweit vernetzt entwickeln wir gemeinsam Lösungen für die globalen Herausforderungen von heute und morgen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sviluppatore SAP senior: in Procurement (m/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurigo, permanente

Per sostenere la ricerca e l'insegnamento, i servizi IT di ETH Zurich operano come un'organizzazione di servizi in un ambiente IT ampio e complesso. Offriamo ai membri di ETH Zurich servizi informatici di alta qualità, flessibili e scalabili e supportarli in competizione con le migliori università del mondo.

Nel gruppo SAP Development, sviluppiamo e gestiamo applicazioni nel back-end e front-end SAP insieme al SAP Competence Center. Lo spettro spazia dalle soluzioni back-end per gruppi di utenti specializzati alle applicazioni web che vengono utilizzate a livello ETH. Integramo anche applicazioni e partner interni ed esterni tramite piattaforme di integrazione come SAP Integration Suite e SAP PI.

Per rafforzare il nostro team, siamo alla ricerca di una personalità esperta e impegnata come Senior SAP Developer: in Procurement (MM) immediatamente o d'accordo.

Descrizione del lavoro

In questa funzione, prendere il controllo Sarai responsabile delle soluzioni SAP nei settori della gestione dei materiali (MM), dell'approvvigionamento e dei relativi processi logistici. Si controllano requisiti complessi da chiarificazione tecnica a soluzione architettura e stima dello sforzo per l'implementazione, l'introduzione e il supporto sostenibile. Prendere decisioni tecniche all'interno dei requisiti di architettura e governance applicabili e garantire sicurezza, manutenbilità, prestazioni e stabilità operativa.

Sviluppi applicazioni e miglioramenti sofisticati nel back-end SAP con ABAP e ABAP orientati agli oggetti e tecnologie moderne come CDS Views, OData, Fiori, SAPUI5 e RAP. Come contatto tecnico, valuterete le varianti di soluzione, definire le immagini di destinazione e gli standard di sviluppo e garantire che le nuove soluzioni tengano conto dei principi di S/4HANA e Clean Core.

Durante il funzionamento, si assume la responsabilità di manutenzione, analisi degli errori, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e supporto di terzo livello. Voi documentate le soluzioni sviluppate, partecipate alla definizione e all'ulteriore sviluppo degli standard di sviluppo e assicurate la qualità delle soluzioni sostenibili attraverso recensioni, test e trasferimento delle conoscenze.

Potrai consigliare i dipartimenti e il SAP Competence Center a livello degli occhi, identificare le dipendenze su SD, FI/CO, HCM e soluzioni di integrazione e sviluppare soluzioni cross-divisional. Rafforzato attraverso trasferimento attivo della conoscenza, coaching e supporto professionale Si uniscono al team di sviluppo e ridurre le dipendenze su individui o partner esterni.

Profilo

Per questo ampio e variegato settore di responsabilità, si porta un alto grado di indipendenza e giudizio, un metodo di lavoro orientato alla soluzione, così come un'università o un'università di laurea in scienze applicate in informatica, informatica aziendale o una formazione comparabile. Inoltre:
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza pratica nello sviluppo SAP, soprattutto con ABAP e ABAP orientati agli oggetti.
• Profonda comprensione dei processi di sviluppo e di business nel modulo SAP MM e l'esperienza nel supporto digitale dei processi di approvvigionamento e logistica.
• Routine nell'intero ciclo di sviluppo dall'analisi e dal concepimento all'introduzione e all'ulteriore sviluppo di soluzioni.
• Esperienza con SAP WebDynpro ABAP e moderne tecnologie SAP come CDS Views, OData, Fiori Elements e RAP.
• Ulteriori conoscenze in SD o FI/CO e punti di contatto con SAP S/4HANA sono un vantaggio.
• L'esperienza con le integrazioni PunchOut basate su OCI e cXML è vantaggiosa.
• Know-how nel collegamento di sistemi tramite IDoc, servizi web, API REST o interfacce comparabili.
• Metodi di lavoro strutturati, orientati alla soluzione e la capacità di implementare requisiti complessi in modo comprensibile e pragmatico.
• Spirito di squadra, responsabilità personale e la volontà di contribuire attivamente e condividere la conoscenza.
• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese per la cooperazione professionale in un ambiente versatile.

Sei flessibile, aperto e capace di lavorare in team, mostrare l'iniziativa e una metodologia di lavoro efficiente e godere di contribuire a modellare le soluzioni SAP centrali a ETH Zurich? Allora vorremmo conoscerti.

Offriamo

Entra a far parte dell'ETH di Zurigo, che non solo supporta il tuo sviluppo professionale, ma contribuisce attivamente ai cambiamenti positivi nella società.

Lavorare per il Vice Presidente delle Infrastrutture e Sostenibilità (VPIN) significa plasmare attivamente il futuro dell'ETH Zurigo – un'istituzione ispiratrice, internazionale e innovativa. Il vostro impegno crea le migliori condizioni per l'eccellenza nell'insegnamento, nella ricerca, nel trasferimento delle conoscenze e nella sostenibilità dell'ETH Zurigo.

In un'atmosfera aperta e stimolante, fiducia, affidabilità e rispetto reciproco costituiscono la base della nostra cooperazione. Non solo vi offriamo la sicurezza, ma anche una vasta gamma di ulteriori opportunità di sviluppo. Con noi, ci si può aspettare un lavoro significativo in un ambiente innovativo e apprezzativo che si può aiutare a modellare e che apre nuove prospettive.
• Un ambiente dinamico e internazionale vi aspetta all'ETH di Zurigo
• Un team aperto consolidato e disponibile e un luogo di lavoro moderno
• C'è spazio per soluzioni pratiche e creative e pratiche sono molto benvenuti
• Viviamo: Apprendimento permanente
• Sconti come abbonamenti di trasporto pubblico e condivisione di auto, ampia offerta sportiva dell'ASVZ, assistenza per bambini, servizi pensionistici attraenti, ecc.

La diversità e la sostenibilità sono importanti per noi

In linea con i nostri valori, ETH Zurich supporta una cultura inclusiva. Promuoviamo pari opportunità, la diversità del valore e coltiviamo un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento che rispetta i diritti e la dignità di tutti i dipendenti e gli studenti. Sul nostro sito web su pari opportunità e diversità, imparerai come garantiamo un ambiente equo e aperto in cui tutti possono svilupparsi e prosperare. La sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale per noi – stiamo costantemente lavorando verso un futuro neutro dal clima.

Curioso? Anche noi.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online con i seguenti documenti:
• Lettera di motivazione
• CVC
• Certificati

Maggiori informazioni sui servizi IT sono disponibili sul nostro sito web. Markus Oswald, markus.oswald@id.ethz.ch (nessun documento di richiesta) è disponibile per informazioni.

Si prega di applicare esclusivamente tramite il portale di applicazione online. Le domande per e-mail o per posta non saranno considerate.

Siamo lieti di sottolineare che la pre-selezione è effettuata dai reclutatori responsabili e non dall'intelligenza artificiale.

Per le agenzie di reclutamento si applicano i termini e le condizioni dell'ETH Zurigo.

Informazioni su ETH Zurich

ETH Zurich è una delle migliori università di scienze tecniche del mondo. Siamo noti per il nostro eccellente insegnamento, la ricerca di base innovativo e il trasferimento diretto di nuovi risultati nella società. Più di 30.000 persone provenienti da oltre 120 paesi trovano un ambiente che promuove il pensiero indipendente e un clima che ispira l'eccellenza. Nel cuore dell'Europa e della rete globale, sviluppiamo insieme soluzioni per le sfide globali di oggi e di domani.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Senior SAP Developer: in Procurement (m/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurich, permanent

To support research and teaching, the IT services of ETH Zurich operate as a service organization in a large and complex IT environment. We offer the members of ETH Zurich high-quality, flexible and scalable computer science services and support them in competition with the best universities in the world.

In the SAP Development group, we develop and operate applications in the SAP back- and front-end together with the SAP Competence Center. The spectrum ranges from back-end solutions for specialized user groups to web applications that are used ETH-wide. We also integrate internal and external applications and partners via integration platforms such as SAP Integration Suite and SAP PI.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced and committed personality as a Senior SAP Developer: in Procurement (MM) immediately or by agreement.

Job description

In this function, take over You will be responsible for SAP solutions in the areas of material management (MM), procurement and related logistics processes. You control complex requirements from technical clarification to solution architecture and effort estimation to implementation, introduction and sustainable support. You make technical decisions within the applicable architectural and governance requirements and ensure security, maintainability, performance and operational stability.

You develop sophisticated applications and enhancements in the SAP back- and front-end with ABAP and object-oriented ABAP as well as modern technologies such as CDS Views, OData, Fiori, SAPUI5 and RAP. As a technical contact, you will assess solution variants, define target images and development standards and ensure that new solutions take into account the principles of S/4HANA and Clean Core.

During operation, you take responsibility for maintenance, error analysis, performance optimization and 3rd-level support. You document the developed solutions, participate in the definition and further development of development standards and ensure sustainable solution quality through reviews, tests and knowledge transfer.

You will advise departments and the SAP Competence Center at eye level, identify dependencies on SD, FI/CO, HCM and integration solutions and develop cross-divisional solutions. Strengthened through active knowledge transfer, coaching and professional support You join the development team and reduce dependencies on individuals or external partners.

Profile

For this broad and varied area of responsibility, you bring a high degree of independence and judgment, a solution-oriented working method, as well as a university or university of applied sciences degree in computer science, business informatics or a comparable education. In addition:
• At least 5 years of practical experience in SAP development, especially with ABAP and object-oriented ABAP.
• Deep understanding of development and business processes in the SAP module MM as well as experience in digital support of procurement and logistics processes.
• Routine in the entire development cycle from analysis and conception to the introduction and further development of solutions.
• Experience with SAP WebDynpro ABAP and modern SAP technologies such as CDS Views, OData, Fiori Elements and RAP.
• Additional knowledge in SD or FI/CO as well as touch points with SAP S/4HANA are a plus.
• Experience with PunchOut integrations based on OCI and cXML is advantageous.
• Know-how in the connection of systems via IDoc, web services, REST APIs or comparable interfaces.
• Structured, solution-oriented working methods as well as the ability to implement complex requirements in an understandable and pragmatic manner.
• Team spirit, personal responsibility and the willingness to actively contribute and share knowledge.
• Very good German and English skills for professional cooperation in a versatile environment.

Are you flexible, open and capable of teamwork, show initiative and an efficient working methodology and enjoy helping to shape central SAP solutions at ETH Zurich? Then we would like to meet you.

We offer

Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive changes in society.

Working for the Vice President of Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) means actively shaping the future of ETH Zurich – an inspiring, international and innovative institution. Your commitment creates the best conditions for excellence in teaching, research, knowledge transfer and sustainability at ETH Zurich.

In an open, inspiring atmosphere, trust, reliability and mutual respect form the foundation of our cooperation. We not only offer you security, but also a wide range of further development opportunities. With us, you can expect meaningful work in an innovative and appreciative environment that you can help shape and that opens up new perspectives.
• A dynamic and international environment awaits you at ETH Zurich
• An established, helpful open team and a modern workplace
• There is room for manoeuvre and practical and creative solutions are very welcome
• We Live: Lifelong Learning
• Discounts such as public transport subscriptions and car sharing, broad sports offer of the ASVZ, child care, attractive pension services, etc.

Diversity and sustainability are important to us

In line with our values, ETH Zurich supports an inclusive culture. We promote equal opportunities, value diversity and cultivate a working and learning environment that respects the rights and dignity of all employees and students. On our website on equal opportunities and diversity, you will learn how we ensure a fair and open environment in which everyone can develop and flourish. Sustainability is a key value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.

Curious? We are too.

We look forward to your online application with the following documents:
• Letter of motivation
• CVC
• Certificates

More information about the IT services can be found on our website. Markus Oswald, markus.oswald@id.ethz.ch (no application documents) is available for information.

Please apply exclusively via the online application portal. Applications by e-mail or by post will not be considered.

We are happy to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

For recruitment agencies, the terms and conditions of ETH Zurich apply.

About ETH Zurich

ETH Zurich is one of the best technical science universities in the world. We are known for our excellent teaching, groundbreaking basic research and the direct transfer of new findings into society. More than 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find an environment that promotes independent thinking and a climate that inspires excellence. In the heart of Europe and globally networked, we jointly develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Développeur SAP senior: dans l'approvisionnement (h/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurich, permanente

Pour soutenir la recherche et l'enseignement, les services informatiques d'ETH Zurich fonctionnent comme une organisation de services dans un environnement informatique vaste et complexe. Nous offrons aux membres d'ETH Zurich des services informatiques de haute qualité, flexibles et évolutives et les soutenons en concurrence avec les meilleures universités du monde.

Dans le groupe de développement SAP, nous développons et exploitons des applications dans le SAP back- and front-end avec le SAP Competence Center. Le spectre va des solutions de back-end pour les groupes d'utilisateurs spécialisés aux applications Web utilisées dans toute l'ETH. Nous intégrons également des applications et des partenaires internes et externes via des plateformes d'intégration telles que SAP Integration Suite et SAP PI.

Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous sommes à la recherche d'une personnalité expérimentée et engagée en tant que développeur SAP senior: dans l'approvisionnement (MM) immédiatement ou par accord.

Description du poste

Dans cette fonction, vous serez responsable des solutions SAP dans les domaines de la gestion du matériel (MM), des achats et des processus logistiques connexes. Vous contrôlez les exigences complexes de la clarification technique à l'architecture de la solution et l'estimation des efforts à la mise en œuvre, l'introduction et le soutien durable. Vous prenez des décisions techniques dans le cadre des exigences architecturales et de gouvernance applicables et vous assurez la sécurité, la maintenance, la performance et la stabilité opérationnelle.

Vous développez des applications et des améliorations sophistiquées dans le SAP back- and front-end avec ABAP et ABAP orienté objet ainsi que des technologies modernes telles que CDS Views, OData, Fiori, SAPUI5 et RAP. En tant que contact technique, vous évaluerez les variantes de solutions, définirez les images cibles et les normes de développement et veillerez à ce que les nouvelles solutions tiennent compte des principes de S/4HANA et Clean Core.

Pendant l'exploitation, vous assumez la responsabilité de la maintenance, de l'analyse des erreurs, de l'optimisation des performances et du support de troisième niveau. Vous documentez les solutions développées, participez à la définition et au développement des normes de développement et assurez la qualité des solutions durables grâce à des examens, des tests et un transfert de connaissances.

Vous conseillerez les départements et le centre de compétences SAP au niveau des yeux, identifierez les dépendances sur le DD, FI/CO, HCM et les solutions d'intégration et développerez des solutions interdivisionnelles. Renforcement par le transfert actif des connaissances, le coaching et le soutien professionnel Vous rejoignez l'équipe de développement et réduisez la dépendance des individus ou des partenaires externes.

Profil

Pour ce vaste et varié domaine de responsabilité, vous apportez un haut degré d'indépendance et de jugement, une méthode de travail orientée vers la solution, ainsi qu'une université ou une université de sciences appliquées diplôme en informatique, en informatique des affaires ou une éducation comparable. En outre:
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pratique dans le développement de SAP, en particulier avec ABAP et ABAP orienté objet.
• Compréhension approfondie des processus de développement et d'affaires du module SAP MM ainsi que de l'expérience en matière de soutien numérique des processus d'approvisionnement et de logistique.
• Routine dans tout le cycle de développement, de l'analyse et de la conception à l'introduction et au développement de solutions.
• Expérience avec SAP WebDynpro ABAP et les technologies SAP modernes telles que CDS Views, OData, Fiori Elements et RAP.
• Des connaissances supplémentaires en SD ou FI/CO ainsi que des points de contact avec SAP S/4HANA sont un plus.

• Méthodes de travail structurées et axées sur les solutions, ainsi que la capacité de mettre en œuvre des exigences complexes de manière compréhensible et pragmatique.

• Très bonnes compétences allemandes et anglaises pour la coopération professionnelle dans un environnement polyvalent.

Devenez membre de l'ETH Zurich, qui non seulement soutient votre développement professionnel, mais contribue également activement à des changements positifs dans la société.

jobs.description:
Doctoral Student in Environmental Bioengineering

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

The Environmental Microfluidics Group of Prof. Roman Stocker in the Institute of Environmental Engineering is seeking a dynamic and motivated doctoral student with an engineering background for a project on how bacterial chemotaxis accelerates plasmid transfer, including the spread of antibiotic resistance. The position is funded by a recently awarded SNSF grant, and the project is a joint effort with Prof. Jonasz Slomka at the University of Warsaw. This position will be based in the laboratory of Prof. Roman Stocker.

Project background

Bacterial conjugation, the contact-dependent transfer of plasmids between cells, speeds up bacterial evolution and is a major route for the spread of antibiotic resistance in the environment, which in turn poses a global health threat. Aquatic environments are full of microscale chemical hotspots, such as the nutrient-rich 'phycosphere' around phytoplankton and sinking marine particles, and chemotactic bacteria are known to find and accumulate rapidly at these locations. This project will test the hypothesis that this accumulation enhances plasmid spreading in the environment, contributing to a cutting-edge view of the role of antibiotic resistance in nature.

The project seeks to study when, where and how strongly this enhancement operates across different chemical hotspots, fluid flows and bacterial strains, and what it means for the spread of antibiotic resistance among aquatic bacteria.

Job description

This is a primarily experimental PhD at the interface of engineering and microbiology. The student will:
• Design, build and characterize new instrumentation to couple existing chemotaxis assays to controlled shear systems. This includes mechanical design, 3D printing, control systems and integration with a fluorescence microscope.
• Run chemotaxis and conjugation experiments with bacterial donors and recipients of plasmids and a range of chemoattractants, with the opportunity to learn and use advanced techniques such as flow cytometry and plate-reader-based plasmid transfer quantification.
• Image and track fluorescently labeled bacteria and chemical plumes in shear flow, and analyze the data with quantitative image- and data-analysis pipelines.
• Test clinically relevant bacteria and freshwater (e.g. lake) bacteria, to assess the potential for chemotaxis-driven spread of resistance in the environment.
• Contribute data to mathematical models of plasmid spread.

Profile

We are looking for a hands-on, skilled and curious engineer who loves to build new tools and is interested in using them to answer fundamental scientific questions. Ideal candidates hold an MSc degree in bioengineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, environmental engineering, physics or a related discipline, and have some (not necessarily all) of the following skills:
• Practical experience in prototyping and manufacturing, for example CAD, 3D printing, machining (strongly preferred).
• Experience with control systems and instrumentation, for example motor control, sensors, microcontrollers, and automation or data-acquisition code (Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW or similar) (preferred).
• Openness to gain experience in the microbiology laboratory: bacterial cultures, sterile technique, plate readers and flow cytometry.
• Familiarity with microscopy, image analysis, fluid mechanics or microfluidics (beneficial but not necessary).
• Fluency in English (oral and written), enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international team, and the drive to pursue scientific excellence (required).

You will be guided by Prof. Roman Stocker and by members of his lab with extensive experience in microbiology, experimental techniques and environmental processes. You will have the opportunity to work in a cutting-edge, fast-paced research environment, interact with researchers from many different disciplines (engineers, physicists, microbiologists, oceanographers, chemists, mathematicians), gain technical experience across diverse research approaches and interact with world-class collaborators.

We offer

ETH Zurich is a family-friendly employer with excellent working conditions. You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application by December 15th, 2026, including the following documents:
• Curriculum vitae
• Cover letter (max one page, including brief motivation, research interests and possible start date)
• Full transcript from undergraduate studies (both Bachelor and Masters, including grades)
• Copy of Master’s or Bachelor’s thesis (PDF)
• At least two reference letters

Further information about The Stocker Lab can be found on our Website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Stefano Ugolini, gugolini@ethz.ch (no applications).

Applications will be reviewed as they are received.

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.
